(ἀμφιποτάομαι, ἐκποτέομαι) To fly about, fly hither and thither : αἱ μέν τʼ ἔνθα ἅλις πεποτήαται, αἱ δέ τε ἔνθα (are on the wing) Il. 2.90, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ποτῶνται 462 : ψυχὴ ἀποπταμένη πεπότηται (hovers about) Od. 11.222, ὡς ὅτε νυκτερίδες ποτέονται Od. 24.7.

peleia/s.head: πελειάς
peleia/s.html: πελειάς -άδος, ἡ. =πέλεια. Il. 11.634. Joined with τρήρων Il. 5.778.

pu/lh.head: πύλη
pu/lh.html: πύλη -ης, ἡ. 1 a A gate of a city or other place Il. 2.809, Il. 4.34, Il. 5.466, Il. 6.80, Il. 9.573, Il. 12.175, etc. b In pl. of a single gate (as consisting of two wings) : πυλέων ἐξέσσυτο Il. 7.1. Cf. Il. 3.145, Il. 5.646, 749, Il. 8.15, Il. 12.120, Il. 13.124, Il. 22.99, Il. 24.709, etc. : Od. 14.156. 2 Of the gates of dreams : ἐν ὀνειρείῃσι πύλῃσιν Od. 4.809. Cf. Od. 19.562. Of the gates of the sun Od. 24.12.

pi/tnhmi.head: πίτνημι
pi/tnhmi.html: πίτνημι [cf. πετάννυμι.] From πιτνάω 3 sing. impf. πίτνα Il. 21.7. To spread, spread out : χεῖρας Od. 11.392. To cause (mist) to be outspread over something, spread or shed (it) Il. 21.7. In pass., to be outspread, flutter : ἀμφὶ χαῖται πίτναντο Il. 22.402.

polua/ic.head: πολυάϊξ
polua/ic.html: πολυάϊξ -ϊκος [πολυ-, πολύς + ἀϊκ-, ἀΐσσω.] Much rushing, impetuous, violent. Epithet of war or battle : πολέμοιο Il. 1.165, Il. 20.328 : Od. 11.314. So κάματος πολυάϊξ, the weariness of many assaultsIl. 5.811.

peli/hs.head: Πελίης
peli/hs.html: Πελίης Son of Poseidon and Tyro. Ruler of Iaolcus Od. 11.254, 256. Father of Alcestis Il. 2.715.

pa/mpan.head: πάμπαν
pa/mpan.html: πάμπαν [παν-, πᾶς reduplicated with assimilation of the Od. 13..] Wholly, altogether, entirely, quite (in negative statements and injunctions commonly rather strengthening the negation than attaching itself closely to the verb, etc., and to be translated at all, by any means, in any wise, or the like ; cf. πάγχυ) : πολέμου ἀποπαύεο π. Il. 1.422, οὐδʼ ὅ γε π. χάζετο Il. 12.406. Cf. Il. 9.435, Il. 13.111, 761, Il. 14.91, Il. 17.406, Il. 20.376, etc. : βίοτον ἀπὸ π. ὀλέσσει Od. 2.49, οὐδʼ Ἀγαμέμνονι π. ἑήνδανεν Od. 3.143. Cf. Od. 4.693, Od. 8.552, Od. 11.528, Od. 16.375, Od. 20.140, etc.

prwto/gonos.head: πρωτόγονος
prwto/gonos.html: πρωτόγονος [πρῶτος + γον-, γεν-, γίγνομαι.] First-born (of the year) : ἀρνῶν (the firstlings) Il. 4.102= 120= Il. 23.864 = 873.

pala/ssw.head: παλάσσω
pala/ssw.html: παλάσσω Fut. infin. παλαξέμεν Od. 13.395. Pf. pple. pass. πεπαλαγμένος, -ου Il. 6.268 : Od. 22.184, 402, Od. 23.48. 3 sing. plupf. πεπάλακτο Il. 11.98, 535, Il. 12.186, Il. 20.400, 500 : Od. 22.406. 1 To spatter, sprinkle : ἐγκέφαλος ἔνδον ἅπας πεπάλακτο Il. 11.98=Il. 12.186=Il. 20.400. 2 To bespatter, besprinkle, wet, befoul : παλάσσεθʼ αἵματι θώρηξ Il. 5.100. Cf. Il. 6.268, Il. 11.169, 535=Il. 20.500, Il. 17.387, Il. 20.504 : Od. 13.395, Od. 22.184, 402 = Od. 23.48, Od. 22.406.

panai/olos.head: παναίολος
panai/olos.html: παναίολος [παν-, πᾶς + αἰόλος.] Glancing or gleaming all over : ζωστήρ Il. 4.186, Il. 10.77. Cf. Il. 4.215, Il. 11.236, 374, Il. 13.552.

protio/ssomai.head: προτιόσσομαι
protio/ssomai.html: προτιόσσομαι [προτι-, προσ- 2.] 1 To direct the eyes towards, look at Od. 7.31, Od. 23.365. 2 To bode, forebode, have a presentiment of, apprehend : ὄλεθρον Od. 5.389, θάνατον Od. 14.219. Absol., to see one's fate before one, forebode it Il. 22.356.

proeru/w.head: †προερύω
proeru/w.html: †προερύω [προ- 1 + ἐρύω1.] 3 sing. aor. προ-έρυσσε Il. 1.308. Subj. προερύσσω Il. 9.358. To draw down (a ship) in order to launch her Il. 1.308, Il. 9.358.

parapla/zw.head: †παραπλάζω
parapla/zw.html: †παραπλάζω [παρα- 4.] 3 sing. aor. παρέπλαγξε Od. 9.81, Od. 20.346. Fem. pple. παραπλάγξασα Od. 19.187. 3 sing. aor. pass. παρεπλάγχθη Il. 15.464. 1 To cause to deviate from the proper course : παρεπλάγχθη οἱ ἄλλῃ ἰός (went wide) Il. 15.464. To drive from one's course and away from. With genit. : κυθήρων Od. 9.81. Cf. Od. 19.187. 2 To disturb or derange (the mind) Od. 20.346.

polu/skarqmos.head: πολύσκαρθμος
polu/skarqmos.html: πολύσκαρθμος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + σκαίρω.] Far-bounding : μυρίνης Il. 2.814.

peristado/n.head: περισταδόν
peristado/n.html: περισταδόν [περι- 1 + στα-, ἵστημι.] Standing round : Τρῶες π. οὔταζον σάκος Il. 13.551.

pa/troklos.head: Πάτροκλος
pa/troklos.html: Πάτροκλος -ου. Also genit. Πατροκλῆος 554 , Il. 17.670, Il. 23.65, 105, 221: Od. 11.468, Od. 24.16. Acc. -ῆα 602, Il. 16.125, 818, Il. 22.331. Voc. -εες 337, Il. 11.823, Il. 16.7, 126, etc. (ἄλκιμος, ἀμύμων, διΐφιλος, διογενής, δῖος, θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος , ἱππεύς, ἱπποκέλευθος , μεγαλήτωρ, Πατροκλῆος λάσιον κῆρ). Patronymic Μενοιτιάδης. Son of Menoetius and comrade of Achilles. Brings out Briseis at the bidding of Achilles Il. 1.337, 345; present with Achilles when the embassy arrives Il. 9.190; summoned by Achilles to ascertain who was the wounded man who passed with Nestor Il. 11.602, reaches Nestor's hut 644, on his way back encounters and succours the wounded Eurypylus-2 807 , Il. 15.390; delivers Nestor's appeal to Achilles Il. 16.2; arms at the bidding of Achilles Il. 16.126, and falls on the foe 257, fights with Sarpedon 427, slays him 480; against Achilles's advice drives the foe too far Il. 16.684, approaches the city 703, but retires before Apollo 710; Apollo brings about his end Il. 16.787, he is wounded by Euphorbus 806, mortally wounded by Hector 818, prophesies Hector's death 843, dies 855; the fight over his body Il. 17.1; Achilles hears of his death Il. 18.15; his corpse is rescued Il. 18.231; the lament of Briseis Il. 19.282; his spirit appears to Achilles Il. 23.65, the material for the pyre collected 110, the pyre 163, the winds summoned to make it burn 192, the funeral games 262; how he had been brought by Menoetius to the house of Peleus Il. 23.85 ; etc.: Od. 3.110; in the Shades Od. 11.468, Od. 24.16; Od. 24.77, 79 .

pela/gwn.head: Πελάγων-1
pela/gwn.html:
Πελάγων-1 Greek. (μέγας) Il. 4.295.
Πελάγων-2 Trojan. (ἴφθιμος). Comrade of Sarpedon, tended him when he was wounded Il. 5.695.

prosamu/nw.head: προσαμύνω
prosamu/nw.html: προσαμύνω [προσ- 3.] Aor. infin. προσαμῦναι Il. 16.509. 1 To bring help or succour to, help, aid. With dat. : ἤ τί οἱ χἠμεῖς προσαμύνομεν Il. 2.238. 2 Absol, to bring succour, make defence, show fight for someone or something Il. 5.139, Il. 16.509.

pouluda/mas.head: Πουλυδάμας
pouluda/mas.html: Πουλυδάμας (ἀγαπήνωρ, ἀγαυός , ἀμώμητος, ἀμύμων , ἐγχέσπαλος, μεγάθυμος , πεπνυμένος). Patronymic Πανθοΐδης. Son of Panthous. Comrade of, and born in the same night with, Hector; excelled in counsel (Il. 18.249). Advises against attempting the ditch with chariots Il. 12.60 ; unsuccessfully advises Hector to give up the attack Il. 12.210; advises Hector to retire Il. 13.725; slays Prothoenor-2 Il. 14.449; slays Mecisteus-2 Il. 15.339; slays Otus-2 Il. 15.518 ; eludes the spear of Meges Il. 15.521; wounds Peneleos Il. 17.600; unsuccessfully advises Hector to retire to the city Il. 18.249; etc.

poimai/nw.head: ποιμαίνω
poimai/nw.html: ποιμαίνω [ποιμήν.] 3 sing. pa. iterative ποιμαίνεσκε Od. 9.188. To tend (a flock) : μῆλα Od. 9.188. Absol., to tend one's flock, act as shepherd : ποιμαίνων (ποιμαίνοντʼ) ἐπʼ ὄεσσιν Il. 6.25, Il. 11.106. In pass., of flocks, to roam the pastures : αἶγας καὶ ὄϊς, τά οἱ ἄσπετα ποιμαίνοντο Il. 11.245.

pu/ris.head: Πύρις
pu/ris.html: Πύρις Trojan. killed by Patroclus Il. 16.416.

prosbai/nw.head: †προσβαίνω
prosbai/nw.html: †προσβαίνω [προσ- 1, προσ- 2.] 3 sing. aor. προσέβη Od. 14.1. 3 pl. προσέβαν Il. 23.117 : Od. 19.431. Pple. προσβάς Il. 5.620, Il. 16.863. 3 sing. aor. mid. προσεβήσετο Il. 2.48, Il. 14.292 : Od. 21.5, 43. 1 To go one's way, proceed, in a specified direction : προσέβη τρηχεῖαν ἀταρπόν (advbl. acc., by a . . .) Od. 14.1. 2 To go to or towards, approach. With acc. : κνημοὺς Ἴδης Il. 23.117. Cf. Od. 19.431. In mid. : Ὄλυμπον Il. 2.48. Cf. Il. 14.292. 3 To step upon, set foot upon. With acc. In mid. : κλίμακα Od. 21.5, οὐδόν 43. Without expressed object : λὰξ προσβάς (setting his foot upon upon the corpse) Il. 5.620, Il. 16.863.

polemi/zw.head: πολεμίζω
polemi/zw.html: πολεμίζω πτολεμίζω [πόλεμος.] Fut. πτολεμίξω Il. 21.463. 1 pl. πολεμίξομεν Il. 24.667. πτολεμίξομεν Il. 2.328. Pple. πολεμίξων Il. 10.451, Il. 15.179. πτολεμίξων Il. 13.644. Infin. πολεμίξειν Il. 20.85. 1 To fight, do battle, take part in the fight, engage in fight : ἐπεί κε κάμω πολεμίζων Il. 1.168, πολεμίζειν οὐκ εἴασκον Il. 5.802. Cf. Il. 2.328, Il. 4.300, Il. 5.520, Il. 8.428, Il. 9.318, etc : Od. 13.315= Od. 15.153, Od. 14.240. Of horses Il. 16.834. Of single combat Il. 3.67, Il. 7.152, Il. 15.179, Il. 20.85, etc. 2 To fight, engage in fight, do battle, with. With dat. : πολεμιζέμεναι Τρώεσσιν Il. 9.337. Cf. Il. 2.121, Il. 11.279, Il. 16.89, Il. 19.168, 325 : Od. 3.86. With the dat. suppressed : ῥηΐτεροι πολεμίζειν (to fight with) Il. 18.258. Of single combat. With dat. : εἰ σοὶ πτολεμίξω Il. 21.463. Cf. Il. 3.435, Il. 7.42, 169, Il. 9.356, Il. 15.539. With cognate acc. : πόλεμον πολεμίζειν Il. 2.121, Il. 3.435.

polukoirani/h.head: πολυκοιρανίη
polukoirani/h.html: πολυκοιρανίη ἡ [πολυ-, πολύς + κοίρανος.] The rule of many Il. 2.204.

prokaqi/zw.head: προκαθίζω
prokaqi/zw.html: προκαθίζω [προ- 1+ καθ-, κατα- 1.] Of birds, to keep settling (ever) forwards Il. 2.463.

perikluto/s.head: περικλυτός
perikluto/s.html: περικλυτός [περι- 6 + κλυτός.] 1 Famed, famous, renowned. Epithet of persons : υἱόν Il. 18.326 : ἀοιδός Od. 1.325, Od. 8.83 = 367 = 521. With a proper name : Ἄντιφος Il. 11.104. Of towns : Μυρμιδόνων ἄστυ Od. 4.9, ἄστυ Od. 16.170, Od. 24.154. Of Hephaestus Il. 1.607, Il. 18.383, 393 = 462, 587, 590 : Od. 8.287, 300, 349, 357, Od. 24.75. 2 Epithet of things, fine, splendid, noble : ἔργα Il. 6.324, δῶρα Il. 7.299, Il. 9.121, Il. 18.449.

peu/kh.head: πεύκη
peu/kh.html: πεύκη -ης, ἡ. A pine-tree Il. 11.494. A felled pine or a piece thereof : ξύλον πεύκης Il. 23.328.

pare/zomai.head: παρέζομαι
pare/zomai.html: παρέζομαι [παρ-, παρα- 2.] In pres. and in impf. (or non-sigmatic aor.; see ἕζομαι). 1 To seat oneself, sit down, take one's seat, beside a person : παρέζεο καὶ λαβὲ γούνων Il. 1.407. 2 To seat oneself, sit down, take one's seat, beside. With dat. : σοὶ παρέζετο Il. 1.557. Cf. Il. 5.889 : Od. 4.738, Od. 20.334.

paifa/ssw.head: παιφάσσω
paifa/ssw.html: παιφάσσω (ἐκ-) To make oneself conspicuous : παιφάσσουσα διέσσυτο λαόν (dazzling) Il. 2.450.

pe/lekus.head: πέλεκυς
pe/lekus.html: πέλεκυς ὁ. Dat. pl. πελέκεσσι Il. 13.391, Il. 15.711, Il. 16.484. An axe (referred to both as in peaceful and in warlike use (cf. ἀξίνη); distinguished from ἡμιπέλεκκον Il. 23.851) : πίτυς, τὴν τέκτονες ἄνδρες ἐξέταμον πελέκεσσιν Il. 13.391=Il. 16.484, πελέκεσσι καὶ ἀξίνῃσι μάχοντο (the two words hardly to be distinguished) Il. 15.711. Cf. Il. 3.60, Il. 17.520, Il. 23.114, 851, 856, 882 : Od. 3.442, 449, Od. 5.234, Od. 9.391, Od. 19.573, 578=Od. 21.76, Od. 21.120, 260, 421.

parapei/qw.head: †παραπείθω
parapei/qw.html: †παραπείθω [παρα- 4.] 3 sing. aor. παρέπεισε Il. 7.120, Il. 13.788, Il. 23.606. 3 sing. aor. subj. παραιπεπίθῃσι (παραι-, παρα-) Od. 22.213. Pple. παρπεπιθών (παρ-, παρα-) Od. 14.290. Nom. pl. παρπεπιθόντες Il. 23.37 : Od. 24.119. Nom. sing. fem. παραιπεπιθοῦσα Il. 14.208. To induce to an act or a course of action, persuade, prevail upon, win over Il. 7.120= Il. 13.788, Il. 14.208, Il. 23.37, 606 : Od. 14.290, Od. 22.213, Od. 24.119.

poqe/w.head: ποθέω
poqe/w.html: ποθέω [ποθή.] Non-thematic pres. infin. ποθήμεναι Od. 12.110. 3 sing. pa. iterative ποθέεσκε Il. 1.492. 3 pl. aor. πόθεσαν Il. 15.219. Infin. ποθέσαι Od. 2.375, Od. 4.748. 1 To feel the want of, long for, yearn for, mourn for, a person or thing absent or lost: ἀϋτήν τε πτόλεμόν τε Il. 1.492. Cf. Il. 5.414, Il. 23.16, Il. 24.6 : τοίην κεφαλήν Od. 1.343. Cf. Od. 9.453, Od. 11.196 (sick with hope of it deferred), Od. 12.110, Od. 18.204, Od. 19.136. 2 To miss, to feel the want of, be at a loss on account of or distressed by the absence or want of : ἀρχόν Il. 2.703 = 726, 778. Cf. Il. 2.709, Il. 5.234, Il. 11.161, Il. 15.219 : Od. 22.387. 3 To miss, remark the absence or loss of : πρίν [μʼ] αὐτὴν ποθέσαι Od. 2.375. Cf. Od. 4.748, Od. 13.219, Od. 16.287= Od. 19.6.

phlia/s.head: Πηλιάς
phlia/s.html: Πηλιάς Adj. from next. Of or from Pelion. Of the spear of Achilles given to Peleus by Cheiron Il. 16.143, Il. 19.390, Od. 3.277, Il. 21.162, Il. 22.133.

perkw/sios.head: Περκώσιος
perkw/sios.html: Περκώσιος Adj. from next Il. 2.831, Il. 6.30, Il. 11.329.

perite/llomai.head: περιτέλλομαι
perite/llomai.html: περιτέλλομαι [περι- 2.] In pple. of the revolving year (cf. περιπέλομαι 2, περιτροπέω 2) : περιτελλομένων ἐνιαυτῶν Il. 2.551. Cf. Il. 8.404 = 418 : Od. 11.295 = Od. 14.294.

pempw/bolon.head: πεμπώβολον
pempw/bolon.html: πεμπώβολον -ου, τό [πέμπε as in πεμπάζομαι + ὀβελός.] A five-pronged sacrificial fork Il. 1.463 :=Od. 3.460.

pelasgiko/s.head: Πελασγικός
pelasgiko/s.html: Πελασγικός Adj. from next of equally disputed meaning. Of Argus-2 Il. 2.681 . Of Zeus of Dodona Il. 16.233.

po/rtac.head: πόρταξ
po/rtac.html: πόρταξ -ακος. = πόρτις. Il. 17.4.

polu/kestos.head: πολύκεστος
polu/kestos.html: πολύκεστος [πολυ-, πολύς + κεστός.] Much embroidered : ἱμάς Il. 3.371.

poluda/kruos.head: πολυδάκρυος
poluda/kruos.html: πολυδάκρυος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + δάκρυον.] =πολύδακρυς.: μάχης Il. 17.192.

po/nos.head: πόνος
po/nos.html: πόνος -ου, ὁ [cf. πένομαι.] 1 Labour, toil, work, trouble : ἐπεὶ παύσαντο πόνου Il. 1.467 = Il. 2.430=Il. 7.319. Cf. Il. 4.26, 57, Il. 5.567 (all they had gone through), 667 (they were too busy), Il. 6.77 (the chief burden), Il. 10.164 : Od. 2.334, Od. 8.529, Od. 11.54 (they had so many other things to attend to), Od. 16.478 = Od. 24.384, Od. 23.249. In pl., toils, troubles, difficulties : τὸν Ζεὺς ἐνέηκε πόνοισιν Il. 10.89. Cf. Il. 10.245, 279: Od. 4.818, Od. 13.301, Od. 20.48. 2 Hardship, suffering, distress : ἄνευθε πόνου καὶ ἀνίης Od. 7.192. Cf. Il. 22.488 : Od. 13.423. So, app., πότε κέν τις ἀναπνεύσειε πόνοιο; Il. 19.227 (referring to the hardship of fasting). 3 Referring specially to the toil and moil of war, war, fighting : καὶ πόνος ἐστὶν ἀνιηθέντα νέεσθαι (we have e'en had fighting enough to disgust a man and send him home) Il. 2.291, ἰαχή τε π. τε Il. 4.456. Cf. Il. 2.420, Il. 5.517, Il. 6.525 (have to bear this heavy burden of war), Od. 11.430, Il. 12.348, Il. 13.2, Il. 14.480, Il. 15.416 (fought their fight), Il. 21.137, Il. 22.11 (app., the slaughtering of them), etc. : Od. 12.117. 4 In concrete sense, a fighting throng : ἔβη ἂμ πόνον ἀνδρῶν Il. 13.239=Il. 16.726=Il. 17.82. The field of battle : φέρον ἐκ πόνου Il. 14.429. Cf. Il. 17.718. 5 The result of toil, weariness Il. 6.355.

pa/ris.head: Πάρις
pa/ris.html: Πάρις often called Ἀλέξανδρος (βασιλεύς, δῖος, θεοειδής). Son of Priam and Hecabe. Carried off Helen from Menelaus and was her husband at Troy. Appears in the front of the Trojans Il. 3.16, but retires before Menelaus 30, reproached by Hector 38 , his duel with Menelaus 340, he is snatched away by Aphrodite and set down in his chamber 380, Helen comes to him 421 ; Hector comes to urge him to the field Il. 6.321, he goes 503, and joins Η. 514, kills Menesthius-1 Il. 7.8; in the assembly refuses to give up Helen Il. 7.355; wounds Diomedes with an arrow Il. 11.369, wounds Machaon with an arrow 505, wounds Eurypylus-2 with an arrow 581; kills Euchenor Il. 13.660, kills Deiochus Il. 15.341; Hector prophesies death to Achilles at the hands of Paris and Apollo Il. 22.359; how he flouted the goddesses Il. 24.28: etc.

poluqarsh/s.head: πολυθαρσής
poluqarsh/s.html: πολυθαρσής -ές [πολυ-, πολύς + θάρσος.] Bold, dauntless : μένος Il. 17.156, Il. 19.37 : Od. 13.387.

pura/grh.head: πυράγρη
pura/grh.html: πυράγρη -ης, ἡ [πῦρ + ἄγρη.] A smith's tongs : γέντο πυράγρην Il. 18.477. Cf. Od. 3.434.

ptu/gma.head: πτύγμα
ptu/gma.html: πτύγμα τό [πτύσσω.] The parts brought together in folding, a fold : πρόσθε οἱ πέπλοιο πτύγμʼ ἐκάλυψεν (folded the loose part of her robe about him) Il. 5.315.

perikallh/s.head: περικαλλής
perikallh/s.html: περικαλλής -ές [περι- 6 + κάλλος.] (Like καλός often used merely as a more or less conventional epithet.) 1 In reference to personal beauty. a Of a woman, fair, lovely, beauteous, comely Il. 5.389, Il. 16.85 : Od. 11.281. b Of parts of the body, fair, lovely, beauteous, goodly : δειρήν Il. 3.396 : ὄσσε Od. 13.401, 433. 2 Of things of use, buildings, constructions, etc., well-made, well-constructed, fair, goodly, fine, beauteous, or the like : φόρμιγγος Il. 1.603, δίφρον Il. 3.262, δόμον Il. 3.421. Cf. Il. 6.321, Il. 8.238, Il. 11.632, Il. 23.897, Il. 24.229, etc. : αὐλῆς Od. 1.425, στειλειόν Od. 5.236, χηλόν Od. 8.438. Cf. Od. 1.153, Od. 3.481, Od. 10.347, Od. 13.149, Od. 17.343, Od. 22.438, etc. 3 In various applications as an epithet of general commendation, fair, goodly, fine, or the like : φηγῷ Il. 5.693, τέμενος Il. 9.578 : ἔργα Od. 2.117=Od. 7.111, λίμνην Od. 3.1, ποταμοῖο ῥόον Od. 6.85, ἀγρούς Od. 14.263=Od. 17.432. Of light, fair, bright : φάος Od. 19.34.

pi/sunos.head: πίσυνος
pi/sunos.html: πίσυνος [πιθ-, πείθω.] Trusting in, relying upon, emboldened by, something. With dat. : τόξοισιν Il. 5.205. Cf. Il. 8.226= Il. 11.9, Il. 9.238, Il. 24.295, 313 : Od. 18.140.

polukagkh/s.head: πολυκαγκής
polukagkh/s.html: πολυκαγκής [πολυ-, πολύς + καγκ- as in κάγκανος.] Parching : δίψαν Il. 11.642.

pi=ar.head: πῖαρ
pi=ar.html: πῖαρ τό [cf. πίων.] Fatness. Hence, rich, fertile soil : μάλα πῖαρ ὑπʼ οὖδάς [ἐστιν] Od. 9.135. The cream or flower of something : βοῶν ἐκ πῖαρ ἑλέσθαι Il. 11.550 = Il. 17.659.

po/te.head: πότε
po/te.html: πότε When? πότʼ ᾤχετο; Od. 4.642. Cf. Il. 19.227.

pali/llogos.head: παλίλλογος
pali/llogos.html: παλίλλογος [πάλιν + λογ-, λέγω2.] Brought together again Il. 1.126 (till they be ...).

protia/wn.head: Προτιάων
protia/wn.html: Προτιάων Father of Astynous-2 Il. 15.455.

pe/ssw.head: πέσσω
pe/ssw.html: πέσσω [πεπ-. Later πέπτω. Cf. πέπων.] (κατα-) 1 To ripen, bring to maturity Od. 7.119. 2 To digest. Fig. : γέρα πεσσέμεν (to brood over them, enjoy them) Il. 2.237, χόλον πέσσει (πέσσων) (nurses (nursing) it, keeps (keeping) it warm) Il. 4.513, Il. 9.565, ὥς τις βέλος πέσσῃ (may hug his wound) Il. 8.513, κήδεα πέσσει (πέσσω) (broods (brood) upon them, dwells (dwell) upon them) Il. 24.617, 639.

peristre/fw.head: †περιστρέφω
peristre/fw.html: †περιστρέφω [περι- 2.] Aor. pple. περιστρέψας. To whirl round (before a throw) Il. 19.131 : Od. 8.189.

pei/sandros.head: Πείσανδρος-1
pei/sandros.html:
Πείσανδρος-1 Trojan. Son of Antimachus. With his brother Hippolochus-2 killed by Agamemnon Il. 11.122 , 143.
Πείσανδρος-2 Trojan. killed by Menelaus Il. 13.601, 606, 611.
Πείσανδρος-3 (ἀρήϊος). Patronymic Μαιμαλίδης. A leader under Achilles Il. 16.193.
Πείσανδρος-4 (ἄναξ). Patronymic Πολυκτορίδης. One of the suitors. His gift to Penelope Od. 18.299; Od. 22.243. Killed by Philoetius Od. 22.268.

po/ris.head: πόρις
po/ris.html: πόρις = ἧπόρτις Od. 10.410.

paxno/w.head: παχνόω
paxno/w.html: παχνόω [as πάχνη.] To freeze, chill. Fig. : ἦτορ παχνοῦται (loses its courage) Il. 17.112.

perimh/dhs.head: Περιμήδης-1.
perimh/dhs.html:
Περιμήδης-1. Father of Schedius-2 Il. 15.515.
Περιμήδης-2. A comrade of Odysseus in his ship Od. 11.23, Od. 12.195.

pe/trh.head: πέτρη
pe/trh.html: πέτρη -ης, ἡ [cf. πέτρος.] 1 A rock or cliff on land or in or bordering upon the sea : πέτρης ἐκ γλαφυρῆς Il. 2.88. Cf. Il. 2.617, Il. 4.107, Il. 9.15, Il. 13.137, Il. 24.614, etc. : πέτρης ἐκ πείσματα δήσας Od. 10.96. Cf. Od. 3.293, Od. 4.501, Od. 5.443, Od. 8.508, Od. 12.59, 241, Od. 13.408, Od. 23.327, etc. 2 The rock forming the walls of a cave : περὶ δʼ ἴαχε πέτρη Od. 9.395, ὁρμαθοῦ ἐκ πέτρης (attached at each end to the walls) Od. 24.8. 3 A large detached mass of stone, a rock : κατερχομένης ὑπὸ πέτρης Od. 9.484 = 541. Cf. Od. 9.243. 4 For οὐκ ἀπὸ δρυὸς οὐδʼ ἀπὸ πέτρης see δρῦς 3.

phrei/h.head: Πηρείη
phrei/h.html: Πηρείη Said to have been in Thessaly. The horses of Eumelus reared there Il. 2.766.

paradarqa/nw.head: †παραδαρθάνω
paradarqa/nw.html: †παραδαρθάνω [παρα- 2.] 3 sing. aor. παρέδραθε Od. 20.88. Infin. παραδραθέειν Il. 14.163. To sleep, go to sleep, take one's rest, beside. With dat. : παρέδραθέ μοι Od. 20.88. Cf. Il. 14.163.

pitu/eia.head: Πιτύεια
pitu/eia.html: Πιτύεια Probably to be identified with Lampsacus (the modern Lampsaki) on the Hellespont Il. 2.829 .

pezo/s.head: πεζός
pezo/s.html: πεζός [for πεδjός, fr. πεδ-, ποδ-, πούς.] 1 On foot : ὄρνυτο π. Il. 5.13. Cf. Il. 4.231, Il. 5.204, Il. 9.329 (in forays by land), Il. 11.230 (as a foot-soldier), 341, 721, Il. 13.385, Il. 17.612, Il. 24.438 : Od. 1.173 = Od. 14.190 = Od. 16.224, Od. 3.324 (by land), Od. 6.319, Od. 9.50, Od. 11.58, 159, Od. 16.59. 2 Absol. in pl., fighters on foot, footmen : πεζοί θʼ ἱππῆές τε Il. 2.810 = Il. 8.59 : = Od. 24.70. Cf. Il. 4.274, 298, Il. 11.150, 529, 724, Il. 12.59, Il. 23.133 : Od. 14.267 = Od. 17.436.

pa/rdalis.head: πάρδαλις
pa/rdalis.html: πάρδαλις ἡ. A panther Il. 13.103, Il. 17.20, Il. 21.573 : Od. 4.457.

polupa/mwn.head: πολυπάμων
polupa/mwn.html: πολυπάμων -ονος [πολυ-, πολύς + πάομαι, to acquire.] Of many possessions, wealthy Il. 4.433.

prodokh/.head: προδοκή
prodokh/.html: προδοκή -ῆς, ἡ [προ- 1 + δοκ-, δέχομαι.] A place where one may lie in wait, a lurking-place. In pl.: δεδεγμένος ἐν προδοκῇσιν Il. 4.107.

purso/s.head: πυρσός
purso/s.html: πυρσός -οῦ, ὁ [πῦρ.] A beacon-fire or signal-fire : πυρσοὶ φλεγέθουσιν Il. 18.211.

parakrema/nnumi.head: †παρακρεμάννυμι
parakrema/nnumi.html: †παρακρεμάννυμι [παρα- 2.] Aor. pple. παρα-κρεμάσας. To let hang by one's side Il. 13.597.

proee/rgw.head: προεέργω
proee/rgw.html: προεέργω [προ- 2.] To stand in front of someone and debar (him from doing something). With infin.: πάντας προέεργε ἐπὶ νῆας ὁδεύειν Il. 11.569.

polu/muqos.head: πολύμυθος
polu/muqos.html: πολύμυθος [πολυ-, πολύς + μῦθος.] Of many words, having a flow of language Il. 3.214 : Od. 2.200.

prolei/pw.head: †προλείπω
prolei/pw.html: †προλείπω [προ- 1.] Aor. pple. προλιπών Od. 3.314, Od. 15.11, Od. 23.120. Pl. προλιπόντες Il. 17.275. Infin. προλιπεῖν Od. 13.331. 3 sing. pf. προλέλοιπε Od. 2.279. 1 To leave, forsake, abandon, leave to one's own devices or to one's (or its) fate: κτήματα Od. 3.314=Od. 15.11 (with ἄνδρας in the same lines simply leaving behind you). Cf. Il. 17.275: Od. 13.331. Of a quality, to forsake (one), fail (him): οὐδέ σε μῆτις Ὀδυσσῆος προλέλοιπεν Od. 2.279. 2 To leave, quit, withdraw from: πηοὺς καὶ πατρίδα γαῖαν Od. 23.120.

paroi/xomai.head: παροίχομαι
paroi/xomai.html: παροίχομαι [παρ-, παρα- 3.] 3 sing. pf. παρ-ῴχωκε, παροίχωκε Il. 10.252 (v. l. παρῴχηκε, as if fr. *παροιχέω). 1 To pass on, go on one's way : παρῴχετο γηθόσυνος κῆρ Il. 4.272 = 326. 2 Of time, to pass, go by Il. 10.252.

pane/llhnes.head: Πανέλληνες
pane/llhnes.html: Πανέλληνες All the Hellenes (with extension of Ἕλληνες to the Greeks in gen.). App hardly to be distinguished from Ἀχαιοί in the same line (see Ἀχαιός 2.b) Il. 2.530.

plei/wn.head: πλείων
plei/wn.html: πλείων -ονος, comp. Neut. πλεῖον [πλε-ίων. Cf. πλεῖστος.] Also πλέων, -ονος. Nom. pl. masc. πλείους Od. 24.464. πλέες Il. 11.395. Dat. pl. πλείοσι Il. 10.106 : Od. 12.196, Od. 19.168. πλεόνεσσι Il. 1.281, 325, Il. 13.739, Il. 15.611, Il. 16.651 : Od. 2.245, 251, Od. 12.54, 164, Od. 16.88, Od. 18.63, Od. 22.13. Acc. πλέας Il. 2.129. 1 More, more numerous, in greater number : πλέας ἔμμεναι υἷας Ἀχαιῶν Τρώων Il. 2.129. Cf. Il. 5.673, Il. 10.106, 506, Il. 11.395, Il. 15.611, etc. : ἀνήϊξαν ἡμίσεων πλείους Od. 24.464. Cf. Od. 2.245, Od. 7.189, Od. 9.48, Od. 12.54, Od. 19.168, etc. Absol. : ἐπεὶ πλεόνεσσιν ἀνάσσει Il. 1.281, οὐδὲ πλείονα ἴσασι μητίσασθαι (have more knowledge so as to . . ., know better how to . . .) Il. 23.312. Cf. Il. 1.325, Il. 5.531, Il. 13.355, Il. 16.651, etc. : Od. 2.251, Od. 12.188, Od. 14.498, Od. 16.88, Od. 18.63, Od. 22.13. 2 Many rather than few. Absol. : πλεόνων ἔργον ἄμεινον Il. 12.412. 3 Greater in quantity or amount : πλέων νύξ (more of the night) Il. 10.252. Absol. : ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἐλέλειπτο Od. 8.475. Cf. Il. 1.165.

pro/noos.head: Πρόνοος
pro/noos.html: Πρόνοος Trojan. killed by Patroclus Il. 16.399.

ph=|.head: πῇ
ph=|.html: πῇ 1 Whither ? where ? πῇ ἔβη Ἀνδρομάχη; Il. 6.377. Cf. Il. 2.339, Il. 5.472, Il. 8.94, 229, 413, Il. 10.385, Il. 14.298, Il. 24.201, 362 : Od. 10.281, Od. 13.203, Od. 15.509, Od. 17.219, Od. 20.43, Od. 21.362. 2 At what point? where ? πῇ μέμονας καταδῦναι ὅμιλον; Il. 13.307. 3 In what way ? how? πῇ κέν τις ὑπεκφύγοι ὄλεθρον; Od. 12.287. Cf. Od. 2.364.

perkno/s.head: περκνός
perkno/s.html: περκνός (ὑποπερκάζω) App., dappled, spotted with dark : αἰετόν, ὃν καὶ περκνὸν καλέουσιν Il. 24.316.

peripeukh/s.head: περιπευκής
peripeukh/s.html: περιπευκής -ές [περι- 6 + πευκ- as in πευκεδανός.] Exceeding sharp, piercing Il. 11.845.

pontopo/ros.head: ποντοπόρος
pontopo/ros.html: ποντοπόρος -ον [πόντος + -πορος, πείρω.] Cleaving the seas. Epithet of ships Il. 1.439, Il. 2.771, Il. 3.46, etc. : Od. 12.69, Od. 14.339, Od. 15.284, etc.

ptolemai=os.head: Πτολεμαῖος
ptolemai=os.html: Πτολεμαῖος Patronymic Πειραΐδης. Father of Eurymedon-1 Il. 4.228.

poludai/dalos.head: πολυδαίδαλος
poludai/dalos.html: πολυδαίδαλος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + δαίδαλον.] 1 Displaying much curious workmanship, elaborately or richly wrought or adorned : θώρηκος Il. 3.358, ἀσπίδα Il. 11.32, κλισμῷ Il. 24.597, etc. : θάλαμον Od. 6.15, χρυσός Od. 13.11, ὅρμον Od. 18.295. 2 Skilled in curious arts : σιδόνες Il. 23.743.

phleu/s.head: Πηλεύς
phleu/s.html: Πηλεύς (ἀμύμων, ἄναξ, γέρων, δαΐφρων, ἱππηλάτα, ἱππότα). Patronymic Αἰακίδης. King of Argus-2. Son of Aeacus, husband of Thetis, and father of Achilles and Polydora. His charge to his son Il. 9.252, Il. 11.783; he received the fugitive Phoenix-1 Il. 9.480; the visit to him of Nestor and Odysseus Il. 11.769 ; his (and Achilles') immortal horses Il. 16.381, 867, Il. 17.443, Il. 23.278; Epeigeus came as a suppliant to him and Thetis Il. 16.574; his armour, given by the gods Il. 18.84; his parentage Il. 21.189; he received the fugitive Patroclus Il. 23.89; his riches and good fortune Il. 24.534; etc.: Od. 11.478, 494, 505, Od. 24.36.

proferh/s.head: προφερής
proferh/s.html: προφερής [προφέρω (with προ- 2). Borne in front.] Comp. προφερέστερος, -η, better, more skilled or serviceable : ἐμεῖο προφερέστεροι Od. 21.134. Cf. Il. 10.352 : Od. 8.221. Superl. προφερέστατος, the best, the most skilled : ἅλματι πάντων προφερέστατος ἦεν (at . . ., in . . .) Od. 8.128.

pru/mnhqen.head: πρύμνηθεν
pru/mnhqen.html: πρύμνηθεν [πρύμνη + -θεν 1.] From, in the direction from, beginning with, the stern : πρύμνηθεν ἐπεὶ λάβε [νῆα] (by the stern) Il. 15.716.

panomfai=os.head: πανομφαῖος
panomfai=os.html: πανομφαῖος [παν-, πᾶς + ὀμφή.] From whom proceed all omens by voices or sounds : Ζηνί Il. 8.250.

proi/hmi.head: †προΐημι
proi/hmi.html: †προΐημι [προ- 1 + ἵημι1.] 3 sing. προΐησι Od. 12.253. 3 pl. προϊεῖσι Il. 11.270. Fem. pple. προϊεῖσα Od. 2.92, Od. 13.381. Aor. προέηκα Il. 8.297, Il. 10.125. 3 sing. προέηκε Il. 4.398, Il. 5.290, Il. 7.468, Il. 11.201, etc.: Od. 2.147, Od. 3.183, Od. 5.268, Od. 14.466, etc. προῆκε Il. 17.545. 3 pl. aor. πρόεσαν Od. 4.681, Od. 8.399, Od. 16.328, Od. 18.291. Imp. πρόες Il. 1.127, Il. 16.38, 241. 3 sing. προέτω Il. 11.796. Infin. προέμεν Od. 10.155. From προϊέω. 3 sing. pres. προϊεῖ Il. 2.752. Impf. προΐειν Od. 9.88, Od. 10.100, Od. 12.9. 2 sing. προΐεις Od. 24.333. 3 sing. προΐει Il. 1.326, Il. 3.118, Il. 5.15, Il. 7.249, etc.: Od. 13.64, Od. 24.519, 522. 1 To send forth, throw, hurl, launch, let fly (a missile): ἔγχος Il. 3.346. Cf. Il. 3.355, Il. 8.297, Il. 13.662, Il. 20.438, etc.: Od. 24.519 = 522. Absol., to throw, make a throw, make one's throw: ὣς φάμενος προέηκεν Il. 5.290. To throw or let fall (fishing tackle) Od. 12.253. 2 To send from oneself, let fall from one's grasp: πόδα Od. 19.468. Cf. Od. 5.316. 3 To let fall (a word), send forth or utter (speech) Od. 14.466, Od. 20.105. 4 Of a river, to send or roll (its waters): Τιταρησσόν, ὅς ῥʼ ἐς πηνειὸν προϊεῖ ὕδωρ Il. 2.752. 5 To send forth or dispatch on a specified or indicated mission or to a specified destination: Βρισηΐδος εἵνεκα κούρης Il. 1.336, Ταλθύβιον νῆας ἔπι ἰέναι Il. 3.118. Cf. Il. 1.326, Il. 7.468, Il. 9.442, Il. 10.125, Il. 11.201, Il. 12.342, etc.: Od. 2.147, Od. 4.161, Od. 8.399, Od. 12.9, Od. 16.328, etc. To let go, surrender: τήνδε θεῷ πρόες Il. 1.127. 6 To send (a wind) Od. 3.183, Od. 5.268=Od. 7.266, Od. 10.25. 7 Of something immaterial, to send: ἀγγελίας Od. 2.92=Od. 13.381. Cf. Il. 11.270, Il. 16.241.

pa/trh.head: πάτρη
pa/trh.html: πάτρη -ης, ἡ [πατρ-, πατήρ.] 1 One's fatherland, birthplace, home : τηλόθι πάτρης Il. 1.30. Cf. Il. 12.243, Il. 24.480, 766, etc. : Od. 2.365, Od. 7.223, Od. 17.318, Od. 19.168, etc. 2 One's parentage : ἀμφοτέροισιν ὁμὸν γένος ἠδʼ ἴα π. Il. 13.354.

phkto/s.head: πηκτός
phkto/s.html: πηκτός [πηκ-, πήγνυμι.] Put together, the work of man's hands. Epithet of a work of mechanical skill : ἄροτρον Il. 10.353, Il. 13.703 : Od. 13.32.

podw/keia.head: ποδώκεια
podw/keia.html: ποδώκεια -ης, ἡ [ποδώκης.] Swiftness of foot. In pl. : ποδωκείῃσι πεποιθώς Il. 2.792.

pa/ndokos.head: Πάνδοκος
pa/ndokos.html: Πάνδοκος Trojan. Killed by Aias-1 Il. 11.490.

ph/lion.head: Πήλιον
ph/lion.html: Πήλιον (εἰνοσίφυλλον). A mountain in Magnesia, southeast of Ossa. The Centaurs driven from it by Peirithous Il. 2.744 (cf. Od. 21.295-304); Il. 2.757 ; the spear of Achilles came thence Il. 16.144, Il. 19.391: the threat of Otus-1 and Ephialtes to pile Ossa on Olympus and Pelion on Ossa Od. 11.315.

pe/nqos.head: πένθος
pe/nqos.html: πένθος τό. 1 Pain of the mind, sorrow, grief, woe, trouble, distress : τί σε φρένας ἵκετο πένθος; Il. 1.362. Cf. Il. 1.254, Il. 9.3, Il. 11.249, Il. 17.37, Il. 24.105, etc. : Od. 1.342, Od. 2.70, Od. 6.169, Od. 7.218, Od. 18.324 (feeling for her), Od. 24.231, etc. 2 A cause of sorrow or grief : τῷ μὲν κλέος ἄμμι δὲ π. Il. 4.197= 207.

ptu/on.head: πτύον
ptu/on.html: πτύον τό. Ablative πτυόφιν. A shovel by which grain, etc., to be winnowed was thrown against the wind ( = ἀθηρηλοιγός) Il. 13.588.

pu/matos.head: πύματος
pu/matos.html: πύματος -η, -ον. 1 Of position, the last, the hindmost : φάλαγγας Il. 4.254. Absol. in pl., those in the rear, the rear rank : ἐν πυμάτοισι κελεύων Il. 11.65. 2 That is at the extremity of something : ἄντυξ ἣ πυμάτη θέεν ἀσπίδος (at its edge) Il. 6.118. The extreme part of the . . ., the extremity of the . . .: ἐξ ἐπιδιφριάδος πυμάτης (its edge) Il. 10.475, ῥινὸς ὕπερ πυμάτης (the top of it) Il. 13.616, ἄντυγα πὰρ πυμάτην σάκεος (the edge of the rim) Il. 18.608. 3 The last in sequence or time : δρόμον Il. 23.373, 768. Cf. Od. 2.20. In oblique cases of that to which action is last directed or which is last affected in some way, last : οὖτιν πύματον ἔδομαι Od. 9.369. Cf. Il. 11.759, Il. 22.66 : Od. 7.138. 4 a In neut. sing. πύματον as adv., for the last time. With ὕστατον in the same sense : π. πε καὶ ὕστατον Il. 22.203 : Od. 20.116. b So in neut. pl. πύματα. With ὕστατα in the same sense : ὕστατα καὶ π. Od. 4.685, Od. 20.13.

patrokasi/gnhtos.head: πατροκασίγνητος
patrokasi/gnhtos.html: πατροκασίγνητος -ου, ὁ [πατρ-, πατήρ + κασίγνητος.] A father's brother, an uncle on the father's side, one's uncle Il. 21.469 : Od. 6.330, Od. 13.342.

pleura/.head: πλευρά
pleura/.html: πλευρά τά [cf. πλευραί.] In collective sense, the side of the body : πλευρὰ οὔτησε ξυστῷ (in the side) Il. 4.468. Cf. Il. 11.437.

pa/ntws.head: πάντως
pa/ntws.html: πάντως [παντ-, πᾶς.] By all means. Strengthening a negative : π. οὐκ ἄν με τρέψειαν (the whole band of them shall not . . .) Il. 8.450 : π. οὔ τί με λήθεις (of a surety you do not . . .) Od. 19.91. Cf. Od. 20.180.

persefo/neia.head: Περσεφόνεια
persefo/neia.html: Περσεφόνεια (ἀγαυή, ἁγνή, Διὸς θυγάτηρ, ἐπαινή). Daughter of Zeus and Demeter (it is no doubt to be understood that it was to the union in Il. 14.326 that she owed her being) and wife of Hades Il. 9.457, 569 : Od. 10.491, 494, 509, 534, 564, Od. 11.47, 213, 217, 226, 386, 635.

polu/kmhtos.head: πολύκμητος
polu/kmhtos.html: πολύκμητος [πολυ-, πολύς + κμη-, κάμνω.] Much or elaborately wrought Il. 6.48 = Il. 10.379 = Il. 11.133 : = Od. 21.10, Od. 14.324. Elaborately or richly adorned : θαλάμοιο Od. 4.718.

po/ros.head: πόρος
po/ros.html: πόρος -ου, ὁ [πορ-, περάω1.] A place where a river may be passed, a ford Il. 2.592, Il. 14.433=Il. 21.1=Il. 24.692.–πόροι ἁλός, the paths of the seaOd. 12.259.

pou.head: που
pou.html: που enclitic. 1 Somewhere : εἴ που ἐφεύροι Il. 4.88. Cf. Il. 5.168, Il. 10.206, Il. 16.514, etc. : Od. 1.94, 197, Od. 4.639, Od. 5.417, Od. 6.278, Od. 20.340, etc. 2 In negative or conditional contexts, anywhere : οὐδέ τί που ἴδμεν ξυνήϊα Il. 1.124. Cf. Il. 6.330, Il. 19.327, etc.: εἴ που ὄπωπας Od. 3.93. Cf. Od. 7.320, Od. 11.458, Od. 14.44, etc. 3 Somehow, haply: ἤν πού τι φόως γένωμαι Il. 16.39. Cf. Il. 7.39, Il. 15.571, etc.: Od. 4.512, Od. 13.418, etc. 4 In negative or conditional contexts, in any way, haply: εἴ τί που ἔστιν Od. 4.193, μή πού τις ἐπαγγείλῃσιν 775. Cf. Il. 9.371, Il. 10.511, Il. 11.366, Il. 13.293, etc.: Od. 2.71, Od. 10.486, Od. 12.300, Od. 15.403, etc. 5 Qualifying an expression, haply, I ween, no doubt, as it would seem: θεός που σοὶ τό γʼ ἔδωκεν Il. 1.178, οὕτω που διὶ μέλλει φίλον εἶναι Il. 2.116. Cf. Il. 3.43, Il. 6.438, Il. 9.628, Il. 10.326, etc.: οἵ πού μʼ ἀσχαλόωσι μένοντες Od. 1.304, Ζηνός που τοιήδε γʼ αὐλή Od. 4.74. Cf. Od. 2.164, Od. 4.756, Od. 6.155, Od. 8.255, Od. 11.139, etc. Sim. in questions, direct and indirect, can it be that? haply, it may be that: οὕτω που ἔλπεαι υἷας Ἀχαιῶν ἀπτολέμους ἔμεναι; Il. 9.40, ἤ ῥʼ ἔτι που σχήσουσιν Ἕκτορα Il. 11.820. Cf. Il. 13.456, etc.: Od. 6.125, 200, Od. 8.584, Od. 13.234, etc.

poiki/los.head: ποικίλος
poiki/los.html: ποικίλος -η, -ον. 1 Parti-coloured, marked with patches of a different colour or shade, dappled : παρδαλέῃ Il. 10.30 : ἐλλόν Od. 19.228. 2 Wrought or ornamented with curious art, elaborately wrought or ornamented. With reference to broidery or ornamental variegated work in wool, etc. : πέπλον Il. 5.735= Il. 8.386. Cf. Il. 14.215, 220, Il. 22.441 : Od. 18.293.– Of various products of art : ἅρματα ποικίλα χαλκῷ (with . . ., i.e. having the metal parts curiously wrought) Il. 4.226, Il. 10.322, 393, θώρηκα Il. 16.134. Cf. Il. 3.327, Il. 4.432, Il. 5.239, Il. 6.504, Il. 10.75, 149, 501, 504, Il. 12.396, Il. 13.181, 537= Il. 14.431, Il. 14.420 : κλισμόν Od. 1.132. Cf. Od. 3.492= Od. 15.145 = 190. 3 Elaborately contrived, intricate, complicated : δεσμόν Od. 8.448.

polu/ktwr.head: Πολύκτωρ-1
polu/ktwr.html:
Πολύκτωρ-1 (ἀφνειός). Given as his father's name by the disguised Hermes to Priam Il. 24.397 .
Πολύκτωρ-2. See Ἴθακος.

pro/sfatos.head: πρόσφατος
pro/sfatos.html: πρόσφατος [προσ-, app. with sense before one's very eyes, in one's view + φα-, φαν-, φαίνω. (As if) newly revealed.] Fresh, unsullied : πρόσφατος κεῖσαι Il. 24.757.

pinuth/.head: πινυτή
pinuth/.html: πινυτή -ῆς, ἡ [cf. πινυτός.] Wisdom, sound understanding, good sense Il. 7.289 : Od. 20.71, 228.

pa/llw.head: πάλλω
pa/llw.html: πάλλω 3 sing. aor. πῆλε Il. 6.474, Il. 16.117. Infin. πῆλαι Il. 16.142, Il. 19.389. 3 sing. aor. pass. πάλτο Il. 15.645. App. imp. pl. aor. mid. πεπάλασθε Il. 7.171. Infin. πεπαλάσθαι Od. 9.331. (For these two forms prob. πεπάλεσθε, πεπαλέσθαι should be read.) (ἀνα-, ἐκ-) 1 To shake, poise, away, brandish, wield (a spear or missile) : δοῦρε δύω πάλλων Il. 3.19. Cf. Il. 5.304, Il. 16.117, 142, Il. 22.320, etc. To dandle (a child) Il. 6.474. 2 In pass., to throb, vibrate, beat : πάλλεται ἦτορ Il. 22.452. Cf. Il. 22.461. App., to be tripped up, trip : ἐν ἀσπίδος ἄντυγι πάλτο Il. 15.645. 3 To shake (lots) together : κλήρους ἐν κυνεῃ πάλλον (πάλλομεν) Il. 3.316=Il. 23.861 : Od. 10.206. Absol., to shake the lots Il. 3.324, Il. 7.181, Il. 23.353. 4 In mid., to cast lots : κλήρῳ πεπάλασθε Il. 7.171, ἐγὼν ἔλαχον ἅλα παλλομένων (partitive genit., of us when we cast lots) Il. 15.191, τῶν μέτα (with them) παλλόμενος κλήρῳ λάχον ... Il. 24.400. Cf. Od. 9.331.

prumno/s.head: πρυμνός
prumno/s.html: πρυμνός -ή, -όν. 1 The hindmost or endmost part of the . . ., the base or root of the . . . (in the case of a part of the body denoting the end next the body) : γλῶσσαν πρυμνήν Il. 5.292, ἄγνυτον ὕλην πρυμνὴν ἐκτάμνοντες (at the bases of the boles) Il. 12.149, ἐξέρυσε πρυμνοῖο βραχίονος ἔγχος Il. 13.532. Cf. Il. 13.705, Il. 16.314, 323 : Od. 17.504. Superl. πρυμνότατος : πρυμνότατον κατὰ νῶτον (i.e. where the back and shoulder join) Od. 17.463. At the base : λᾶας πρυμνὸς παχύς Il. 12.446. 2 App. in neut. as sb., the root (of the . . .) : πρυμνὸν ὕπερ θέναρος Il. 5.339. 3 App. in neut. as adv., by the root : ἐξ ὀδόντας ὦσε δόρυ πρυμνόν Il. 17.618.

plh/cippos.head: πλήξιππος
plh/cippos.html: πλήξιππος [πληξ-, πλήσσω + ἵππος.] Smiter of horses. Epithet of Pelops Il. 2.104. Of Menestheus Il. 4.327. Of Orestes Il. 5.705. Of Oïleus Il. 11.93.

pe/leia.head: πέλεια
pe/leia.html: πέλεια ἡ. A wild dove or pigeon Il. 21.493 : Od. 15.527, Od. 22.468. Joined with τρήρων Il. 22.140, Il. 23.853, 855, 874 : Od. 12.62, Od. 20.243.

pu/rasos.head: Πύρασος-1
pu/rasos.html:
Πύρασος-1 (ἀνθεμόεις). A town in the realm of Protesilaus with a τέμενος of Demeter Il. 2.695.
Πύρασος-2 Trojan. Killed by Aias-1 Il. 11.491.

pro/teros.head: πρότερος
pro/teros.html: πρότερος -η, -ον [comp. fr. πρό.] 1 That is in front : ἐν προτέροισι πόδεσσιν (his fore-paws) Od. 19.228. 2 Sooner, earlier : οὔ τις π. τόν γʼ εἴσεται (before you) Il. 1.548, π. γεγόνει (had been born before him, was the elder) Il. 13.355. Cf. Il. 17.14, Il. 19.219, Il. 21.440 : Od. 2.31, 43. With genit., sooner than, before : ἐμέο π. ἐπέγρετο Il. 10.124. With πρίν: οὐκ εἴων προτέρην αἵματος ἆσσον ἴμεν, πρὶν . . . (to do so before . . ., until I should . . .) Od. 11.88. 3 In neut. sing. πρότερον as adv., sooner Il. 14.467. 4 a Doing, succeeding in doing, something before another, anticipating him, taking the lead or initiative, assuming the aggressive, commencing, first (cf. πρῶτος 5..a) : ὁππότεροι πρότεροι πημήνειαν Il. 3.299, πρότερος προΐει ἔγχος Il. 5.15. Cf. Il. 3.351, Il. 4.67, Il. 5.276, Il. 8.253 (cutting in), Il. 16.569, Il. 19.183, etc. : Od. 3.13, Od. 16.460, Od. 20.394, Od. 24.23, etc. b Sim. in oblique cases of one to whom action is directed before another, first (cf. πρῶτος 5..b) : ὑμῖν πὰρ προτέροισι πυρὸν ἔθηκεν Il. 8.188. Cf. Il. 15.157 : Od. 3.50, 53. 5 Belonging to time past : ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων (in the days of the men of old) Il. 5.637, Il. 23.332. Cf. Il. 11.691, Il. 21.405 : Od. 8.223, Od. 11.630. Absol. in pl., the men of old : οἱ πρότεροι Il. 4.308. 6 Born sooner, older : π. καὶ ἀρείων Il. 2.707, Il. 23.588 : Od. 19.184. Cf. Il. 15.166, 182. 7 Belonging to the past as opposed to the present, the former . . ., one's former . . .: ἀνδρός Il. 3.140. Cf. Il. 3.163, 429 : Od. 15.22, Od. 19.504, Od. 22.264 (to add to the former wrongs). The preceding . . . : ἠοῖ τῇ προτέρῃ Il. 13.794. Cf. Il. 21.5, Il. 23.790 (of the last generation and the men who lived then). Absol. : τῇ προτέρῃ (sc. ἡμέρῃ), the day before Od. 16.50.

prw=tos.head: πρῶτος
prw=tos.html: πρῶτος -η, -ον [πρόατος, superl. fr. πρό.] 1 In reference to position, the most advanced in a specified or indicated direction, the first or foremost : οἱ πρῶτοί τε καὶ ὕστατοι Il. 2.281. Cf. Il. 4.480 (in the forefront of the fray), Il. 6.445, Il. 8.83, Il. 12.260 (against the face of the works), 315, 321, Il. 14.31 (next the plain), 75 (next the sea), Il. 15.634, 654 (next the plain), 656, Il. 16.394, Il. 18.579, Il. 21.90 : Od. 8.197, Od. 15.36 (the first in your course), Od. 18.379. 2 The foremost or front part of the . . ., the front of the . . . : ἐν πρώτῳ ῥυμῷ Il. 6.40, Il. 16.371. Cf. Il. 8.411 (just in front of the gate, at the entrance to it), Il. 15.340 (in the front of the fight), Il. 17.380, 471, Il. 19.50, Il. 20.173, 275 (the edge), 395, Il. 22.66 (before the house-door), Il. 24.272 : Od. 1.255 (just within the door), Od. 21.422 (the top of the . . .), Od. 22.250. 3 Absol., the winner in a contest : ἄεθλα τῷ πρώτῳ Il. 23.265. In neut. pl. τὰ πρῶτα, the first prizeIl. 23.275, 538. 4 Absol. in pl. a Those who stand or advance in or to the front of the fray, the front rank : ἐνὶ πρώτοισι μάχεσθαι Il. 9.709. Cf. Il. 4.341, Il. 5.536, Il. 8.337, Il. 11.61, etc. b The most promnent in some sphere of activity : μετὰ πρώτοισι πονεῖτο (with the best) Il. 9.12. c The first in social rank, the leading men Od. 6.60. d Gen., the most distinguished, the first : ἐν πρώτοισιν ὀΐω ἔμμεναι Od. 8.180. Cf. Il. 15.643. 5 a Being the first to do something, first, giving a lead, showing the way, taking the initiative, doing something before another, anticipating him (cf. πρότερος 4..a) : πρῶτος κελόμην Il. 1.386, οὐδὲ σέθεν θεοὶ λελάθοντο, πρώτη δὲ Διὸς θυγάτηρ (i.e. she was the first to bethink her of you) Il. 4.128, πρώτῳ στρεφθέντι (i.e. he was the first to flee) Il. 5.40. Cf. Il. 4.343, 459, 457, Il. 5.38, Il. 6.5, Il. 10.532, Il. 13.809, Il. 16.812, Il. 20.161 (leaving his fellows the first), etc. : Od. 1.113, Od. 3.36, Od. 8.216, Od. 11.51, Od. 22.212, etc. b Sim. in oblique cases of that to which action is first directed or which is first affected in some way, first (cf. πρότερος 4..b) : τίνα πρῶτον ἐξενάριξαν; Il. 5.703, πὰρ σοὶ πρώτῳ πασάμην ἀκτήν (i.e. formed thus a tie with you first of the Greeks) Il. 21.76. Cf. Il. 5.829, Il. 10.18, Il. 13.46, Il. 17.553, etc. : Od. 2.39, Od. 4.452, Od. 6.176, Od. 7.237 (I will begin by asking you), Od. 8.462, Od. 9.14, Od. 11.235, Od. 21.304, etc. 6 In neut. sing. (τὸ) πρῶτον and pl. (τὰ) πρῶτα as adv. a In front. (i) πρῶτον ἀντιάσαντες (forming a screen to cover the retreat) Il. 15.297. (ii) ἱππῆας πρῶτα στῆσεν Il. 4.297, πρῶτα περὶ τέρμα βαλούσας (leading) Il. 23.462. b First, in the first place, first of all, to begin with (as opposed to subsequent action). (i) βουλὴν πρῶτον ἷζεν Il. 2.53, πρῶτον μίνωα τέκεν (this was the beginning of the race) Il. 13.450. Cf. Il. 3.315, Il. 6.179, Il. 11.628, Il. 14.170, Il. 23.237, etc. : Od. 2.190, Od. 4.411, Od. 8.120, Od. 12.39, Od. 13.117, Od. 16.173, Od. 24.240, etc. (ii) αὐέρυσαν πρῶτα Il. 1.459. Cf. Il. 2.73, Il. 3.330, Il. 5.458, Il. 9.32, Il. 11.244, Il. 21.343, etc. : γυρῇσίν μιν πρῶτʼ ἐπέλασσε Od. 4.500 (taken up by 502; this was the first stage of his fate), ναυσίθοον πρῶτα Ποσειδάων γείνατο (this was the beginning of the race) Od. 7.56. Cf. Od. 10.154, 519, Od. 11.158, Od. 18.192, Od. 23.131, etc. c In advbl. use corresponding α To the adjectival use 5.a, first. (i) οἱ ἓξ πρῶτον ἀκοντίσατε Od. 22.252. (ii) ἴστω Ζεὺς πρῶτα Il. 19.258 := Od. 19.303, Od. 14.158= Od. 17.155= Od. 20.230, ἦ πρῶτʼ ἐξερέοιτο (anticipate him, begin the conversation) Od. 4.119. β To the adjectival use 5.b, first. (i) οὐρῆας πρῶτον ἐπῴχετο (they were the first to be attacked) Il. 1.50. (ii) Ὀρσίλοχον πρῶθʼ ἕλεν (he was the first man slain) Il. 8.274. Cf. Il. 11.301, Il. 16.694, Il. 23.262 : πρῶτʼ ἐς πύλον ἐλθέ (let Pylus be your first goal) Od. 1.284, δέσποιναν πρῶτα κιχήσεαι Od. 7.53, αὐτόν σε πρῶτα σάω (let your own safety be your first care) Od. 17.595. Cf. Od. 13.228, Od. 17.573. Sim. : ἔνθεν μιν ἐδέγμην πρῶτα φανεῖσθαι Od. 12.230 (i.e. he thought he should catch sight of her from that position sooner than from elsewhere). d In reference to the first doing or occurrence of something, for the first time, first. (i) ὅθι πρῶτον λιπέτην ἅλα Il. 14.284 (they did not leave it till they reached that point), πρῶτον ὑπηνήτῃ (newly) Il. 24.348 : Od. 10.279. Cf. Il. 14.295, Il. 16.113. (ii) ἐλθὼν τὸ πρῶτον Od. 4.159. (iii) ὅθι πρῶτʼ ἐμβασίλευεν (had his first period of kingship) Il. 2.572, οὐ νῦν πρῶτʼ ἄντʼ Ἀχιλῆος στήσομαι Il. 20.89. Cf. Il. 16.811 : Od. 15.420. (iv) τοῖος οἷόν μιν τὰ πρῶτʼ ἐνόησα Od. 1.257. Cf. Od. 8.268. e With a temporal conjunction, when first, as soon as : ἐπὴν δὴ πρῶτα κατευνηθέντα ἴδησθε Od. 4.414. f At first, to begin with (implying a subsequent change). (i) πρῶτον ἀτίζων ἔρχεται Il. 20.166. (ii) πόντῳ πρῶτα κορύσσεται [κῦμα] Il. 4.424. Cf. Il. 4.442 : Od. 11.640. (iii) πεζὸς τὰ πρῶτʼ ἤλυθεν Il. 17.612. Cf. Il. 23.523.– g Before doing something, as a preliminary, first. (i) ἄλλην χρὴ πρῶτον ὁδὸν τελέσαι Od. 10.490. (ii) πρῶτα θεῶν εἰρώμεθα βουλάς Od. 16.402. Cf. Il. 10.344.– h In reference to preference or choice, first, before anything else : πρῶτον τοῦ πατρὸς ἑλοίμεθα νόστιμον ἦμαρ Od. 16.149.– i At once, straightway : οὕνεκά σʼ οὐ τὸ πρῶτον, ἐπεὶ ἴδον, ὧδʼ ἀγάπησα Od. 23.214.– j Marking the time of an action or occurrence as a point of departure, a beginning, an opening of a new era. (i) ὅτε σε πρῶτον ἔπλεον ἁρπάξας (since first I . . .) Il. 3.443, ὅθι πρῶτον ἐξαίνυτο θυμόν (where he began by slaying him) Il. 5.848, ὅτε με πρῶτον τέκε μήτηρ (and so brought me into all this woe) Il. 6.345, ἀλκήν μοι πρῶτον ὀνείδισας (you began it by reflecting on my valour) Il. 9.34, ὅτε πρῶτον λίπον Ἑλλάδα (when first I . . .) 447 : ὁππότε κε πρῶτον πελάσῃς νῆα Θρινακίῃ (then will come the time for prudence) Od. 11.106, ὅθι πρῶτον γενόμην (where I had my first being) Od. 14.141, ὅτε μιν πρῶτον τέκε μήτηρ Od. 19.355. (ii) τὸ πρῶτον ἀάσθη (and so brought his fate upon him) Od. 4.509. (iii) ἐξ ἧς πρῶτα καὶ ἡμέας ἵκετο πένθος (first came upon us) Od. 23.224. (iv) μῆνιν ἄειδε . . . ἐξ οὗ τὰ πρῶτα διαστήτην (take up the tale from the point when first . . ., i.e. from the beginning of the quarrel) Il. 1.6, ᾗ τὰ πρῶτα πύλας ἐσᾶλτο (began the attack) Il. 13.679.– k Denoting fixity of determination, purpose or condition, or that something is done or brought about finally or completely, once for all. (i) ὥς οἱ ὑπέστην πρῶτον Il. 15.75, ὥς σφιν πρῶτον ἀπήχθετο Ἴλιος Il. 24.27, ἐπεί με πρῶτον ἔασας 557. Cf. Il. 1.319, Il. 19.136 : Od. 4.6, Od. 13.127, 133. (ii) ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ὑπέστην Il. 4.267, ὅππως τὸ πρῶτον τανύσῃ [ἵππους] (from the start) Il. 23.324. (iii) ὥς οἱ πρῶτα δόσαν γέρας Il. 1.276, ἐπεὶ δὴ πρῶτα δαμάσθη (let us accept that and make the best of it) Il. 19.9.– l Denoting inevitability of consequence or of the continuance of a state or condition on the doing or occurrence of something, (when) once . . ., (since) once . . ., (who) once . . . (i) εὖτʼ ἄν πρῶτον ὁμιλήσωσι φάλαγγες Il. 19.158. Cf. Il. 13.285 : ὅτε πρῶτον κρήτης ὄρεα νοσφισάμην (ever since . . .) Od. 19.338. Cf. Od. 3.320, Od. 10.328. (ii) ἐπεὶ δὴ τὸ πρῶτον ἐγείνατο παῖδα Od. 4.13, ἐπεὶ τὸ πρῶτον ἀνέκραγον (and so committed myself) Od. 14.467. (iii) ἐπεὶ δὴ πρῶτα τομὴν λέλοιπεν Il. 1.235. Cf. Il. 17.427 : ἐπεί κε πρῶτα λίπῃ ὀστέα θυμός Od. 11.221. Cf. Od. 3.183. (iv) ἐπὴν τὰ πρῶτα γένηται Il. 6.489. Cf. Il. 12.420 : Od. 8.553.

perii/sthmi.head: †περιίστημι
perii/sthmi.html: †περιίστημι [περι- 1.] 3 pl. aor. περίστησαν Il. 4.532. 3 pl. subj. περιστήωσι Il. 17.95. 3 pl. opt. περισταῖεν Od. 20.50. 3 sing. impf. mid. περιίστατο Il. 18.603. 3 pl. aor. περιστήσαντο Il. 2.410 : Od. 12.356. 3 sing. aor. pass. περιστάθη Od. 11.243. To take one's stand round about : περίστησαν ἑταῖροι Il. 4.532. In pass., of an arching wave, to remain stationary round something, enfold it, cover it from view : κῦμα περιστάθη κυρτωθέν Od. 11.243. In mid. and non-sigmatic aor., to stand round, surround. With acc.: μή με περιστήωσιν Il. 17.95, πολλὸς χορὸν περιίσταθʼ ὅμιλος Il. 18.603 : εἴ περ πεντήκοντα λόχοι νῶϊ περισταῖεν Od. 20.50. So in mid. in sigmatic aor. : βοῦν περιστήσαντο Il. 2.410. Cf. Od. 12.356.

polla/kis.head: πολλάκις
polla/kis.html: πολλάκις πολλάκι. [πολλός.] Often, many a time Il. 1.396, Il. 3.232, Il. 8.362, Il. 9.490, Il. 10.121, Il. 13.666, Il. 17.408, Il. 19.85, Il. 23.281: Od. 4.101, Od. 16.443, Od. 17.420= Od. 19.76, Od. 22.322.

polu/frwn.head: πολύφρων
polu/frwn.html: πολύφρων -ονος [πολυ-, πολύς + φρήν.] Of great intelligence or sense, sensible, discreet. Absol. : ἐφέηκε πολύφρονά περ χαλεπῆναι Il. 18.108. Cf. Od. 14.464. As epithet of Hephaestus, of high intellectual capacity, ingenious, skilful Il. 21.367 : Od. 8.297, 327. In sim. sense as epithet of Odysseus Od. 1.83 = Od. 14.424 = Od. 20.239 = Od. 21.204, Od. 20.329.

peiri/qoos.head: Πειρίθοος
peiri/qoos.html: Πειρίθοος (ἐρικυδής, θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος, μεγάθυμος). A Lapith. Son of Zeus and Dia (see Ἰξιόνιος), husband of Hippodameia-1 and father of Polypoetes Il. 2.741 ; Eurytion's disturbance at his marriage and the expulsion of the Centaurs Il. 2.742: Od. 21.296, 298; a warrior of Nestor's youth Il. 1.263: Od. 11.631; Il. 12.129, 182, Il. 14.318.

plhsi/os.head: πλησίος
plhsi/os.html: πλησίος -η, -ον [πέλας.] 1 Near, close : πλησίαι αἵ γʼ ἥσθην (close to each other) Il. 4.21= Il. 8.458. Cf. Il. 11.593= Il. 13.488, Il. 2.271 (his neighbour) = Il. 4.81= Il. 22.372 : = Od. 8.328 = Od. 10.37= Od. 13.167= Od. 18.72 = 400= Od. 21.396, Od. 10.93. Near to, close to. With genit. : ἀλλήλων Od. 5.71. With dat. : ἀλλήλοισιν Il. 23.732 : Od. 2.149. 2 In neut. sing. πλησίον as adv., near, close, close by : ἑστήκει Il. 4.329. Cf. Il. 18.422 : Od. 8.7 (in a body), Od. 20.106 (from near at hand). Near to, close to. With genit. : ἀλλήλων Il. 3.115, Il. 6.245, 249. Cf. Od. 12.102, Od. 14.14. With dat. : οἱ Od. 7.171.

po/dargos.head: Πόδαργος-1.
po/dargos.html:
Πόδαργος-1. One of Hector's horses Il. 8.185.
Πόδαργος-2. One of Menelaus's horses Il. 23.295.

perigi/gnomai.head: περιγίγνομαι
perigi/gnomai.html: περιγίγνομαι [περι- 3.] To excel, outrival, surpass. With genit.: ὅσσον περιγιγνόμεθʼ ἄλλων Od. 8.102= 252. To prove superior to, get the better of, beat. With genit. : μήτι ἡνίοχος περιγίγνεται ἡνιόχοιο Il. 23.318.

phne/lews.head: Πηνέλεως
phne/lews.html: Πηνέλεως -έωο (ἄναξ, δαΐφρων) . A leader of the Boeotians Il. 2.494; Il. 13.92; slays Ilioneus Il. 14.487, 489, 496; slays Lycon Il. 16.335 , 340; wounded by Poulydamas Il. 17.597.

pidh/eis.head: πιδήεις
pidh/eis.html: πιδήεις -εσσα [cf. πῖδαξ.] With many springs, many - fountained. Epithet of Mount Ida Il. 11.183.

pi/tus.head: πίτυς
pi/tus.html: πίτυς ἡ. Dat. pl. πίτυσσι Od. 9.186. A pine-tree Il. 13.390= Il. 16.483. A felled pine or a piece thereof : δέδμητο πίτυσσιν ἰδὲ δρυσίν Od. 9.186.

pallaki/s.head: παλλακίς
pallaki/s.html: παλλακίς -ίδος, ἥ A concubine : ἔμʼ ὠνητὴ τέκε μήτηρ, π. Od. 14.203. Cf. Il. 9.449, 452.

pi/qos.head: πίθος
pi/qos.html: πίθος -ου, ὁ. A large jar : πίθοι οἴνοιο Od. 2.340. Cf. Il. 24.527 : Od. 23.305.

pulaime/nhs.head: Πυλαιμένης
pulaime/nhs.html: Πυλαιμένης (ἀτάλαντος Ἄρηϊ, Πυλαιμένεος λάσιον κῆρ). Father of Harpalion and leader of the Paphlagonians Il. 2.851 . Killed by Menelaus Il. 5.576; Il. 13.643. (He is represented as alive in Il. 13.658.)

porqe/w.head: πορθέω
porqe/w.html: πορθέω [cf. πέρθω.] (δια-) To sack or ravage (a town or land) Il. 4.308 : Od. 14.264= Od. 17.433.

polulh/ios.head: πολυλήϊος
polulh/ios.html: πολυλήϊος [πολυ-, πολύς + λήϊον.] Having much corn-land Il. 5.613.

perixe/w.head: †περιχέω
perixe/w.html: †περιχέω [περι- 1.] 3 sing. aor. περίχευε Od. 3.437, Od. 7.140, Od. 23.162. 3 sing. subj. περιχεύῃ Od. 3.426. Pple. περιχεύας Il. 10.294, Il. 21.319 : Od. 3.384. 3 sing. aor. subj. mid. περιχεύεται Od. 6.232, Od. 23.159. 1 To shed or spread something round or over another thing : χέραδος περιχεύας Il. 21.319. To shed round. With dat. : ἠέῤ, ἥν οἱ περίχευεν Ἀθήνη Od. 7.140. So of something immaterial : τῷ περίχευε χάριν Od. 23.162. 2 To spread round, put round as a covering or adornment. With dat. : χρυσὸν κέρασιν περιχεύας Il. 10.294 : = Od. 3.384. Cf. Od. 3.426, 437. So of spreading one metal on the ground of another in, app., some process of enamel : ὡς ὅτε τις χρυσὸν περιχεύεται ἀργύρῳ Od. 6.232 = Od. 23.159.

puka/zw.head: πυκάζω
puka/zw.html: πυκάζω [πύκα.] 3 sing. aor. πύκασε Il. 8.124, 316, Il. 10.271, Il. 17.83. Pple. πυκάσας Il. 24.581. Fem. πυκάσασα Il. 17.551. Infin. πυκάσαι Od. 11.320. Pf. pple. pass. πεπυκασμένος Il. 14.289 : Od. 22.488. Nom. pl. neut. πεπυκασμένα Il. 2.777, Il. 23.503. 1 To put something round or about (something), cover, cover up, for protection, concealment or decency : νέκυν πυκάσας Il. 24.581. Cf. Il. 2.777, Il. 14.289, Il. 17.551 : ῥάκεσιν πεπυκασμένος Od. 22.488. To protect, shield : πύκασεν κάρη [κυνέη] Il. 10.271. To shelter or conceal (oneself) : μή πως ἐντὸς πυκάζοιεν σφέας αὐτούς Od. 12.225. To cover the surface of by way of ornamentation : ἅρματα χρυσῷ πεπυκασμένα Od. 23.503. In reference to something growing upon and covering a surface : πρίν σφωϊν ἰούλους πυκάσαι γένυς λάχνῃ Od. 11.320. 2 Of grief overwhelming (a person) : Ἕκτορʼ ἄχος πύκασε φρένας Il. 8.124= 316, Il. 17.83.

probi/bhmi.head: προβίβημι
probi/bhmi.html: προβίβημι [προ- 1.] To stride along forwards, make one's way or advance with a stride: κραιπνὰ ποσὶ προβιβάς Il. 13.18. Cf. Il. 13.158: Od. 15.555, Od. 17.27. (And see προβιβάω.)

ptu/w.head: πτύω
ptu/w.html: πτύω (ἀπο-, ἐκ-) To spit out : αἷμα Il. 23.697.

parelau/nw.head: †παρελαύνω
parelau/nw.html: †παρελαύνω [παρ-, παρα- 3.] 3 sing. aor. παρήλασε Od. 12.186. παρέλασσε Il. 23.382, 527. 3 pl. παρήλασαν Il. 23.638 : Od. 12.197. Infin. παρελάσσαι Il. 23.427. 1 a To drive one's chariot past another, outstrip him in the race : ἤ κε παρέλασσʼ ἢ ἀμφήριστον ἔθηκεν Il. 23.382. Cf. Il. 23.427. b To sail past a specified point : οὔ πώ τις τῇδε παρήλασεν Od. 12.186. 2 With acc. a To drive past, out-strip, in the chariot-race : παρέλασσέ κέ μιν Il. 23.527. Cf. Il. 23.638. b To sail past : σειρῆνας Od. 12.197.

polutlh/mwn.head: πολυτλήμων
polutlh/mwn.html: πολυτλήμων [as πολύτλας.] = πολύτλας. : θυμός Il. 7.152 : πολυτλήμων εἰμί Od. 18.319.

pate/w.head: πατέω
pate/w.html: πατέω [πάτος.] To trample under foot. Fig.: καθʼ ὅρκια πάτησαν Il. 4.157.

prwtesi/laos.head: Πρωτεσίλαος
prwtesi/laos.html: Πρωτεσίλαος (ἀρήϊος, μεγάθυμος ). Son of Iphiclus-1 and elder brother german of Podarces. Leader of the men of various towns lying about the west coast of the Pagasaean Gulf. Was slain in landing first of the Greeks and was succeeded by Podarces Il. 2.698, 706, 708; the position of his ships Il. 13.681; fighting round his ship Il. 15.705; the ship set on fire Il. 16.122, the fire extinguished 286, 293 .

ph/daios.head: Πήδαιος
ph/daios.html: Πήδαιος Trojan. Bastard son of Antenor. Killed by Meges Il. 5.69 .

pi=los.head: πῖλος
pi=los.html: πῖλος ὁ. Felt Il. 10.265.

proqo/wn.head: Προθόων
proqo/wn.html: Προθόων Trojan. killed by Teucrus Il. 14.515.

pei=rar.head: πεῖραρ
pei=rar.html: πεῖραρ -ατος, τό. 1 A rope or cord : ἐξ αὐτοῦ πείρατʼ ἀνήφθω (ἀνῆπτον) Od. 12.51 = 162, 179. Fig. of the rope of strife (see ἐπαλλάσσω) Il. 13.359. 2 In derived senses (app. coming through the notion of a measuring-rope, but the original sense in the end quite lost sight of). a An end, limit, boundary: πείρατα γαίης Il. 14.200, 301. Cf. Il. 8.478 : Od. 4.563, Od. 9.284, Od. 11.13. b The end or termination of something. In pl. : οὔ πω ἐπὶ πείρατʼ ἀέθλων ἤλθομεν Od. 23.248. c The coming to pass, the crisis or supreme moment, of something (cf. τέλος 5). In pl. : ὥς κεν θᾶσσον ὀλέθρου πείραθʼ ἵκηαι Il. 6.143 = Il. 20.429. Cf. Il. 7.402, Il. 12.79 : Od. 22.33, 41. d An extreme stage or crisis of something : μέγα π. ὀϊζύος Od. 5.289. e A decision or determination : ἐπὶ ἴστορι π. ἑλέσθαι Il. 18.501. f The issue or event in respect of something. In pl. : νίκης πείρατα Il. 7.102.– g In pl., the final or essential points, the sum or substance, of something (cf. τέλος 7) : ἐπεὶ ᾧ παιδὶ ἑκάστου πείρατʼ ἔειπεν Il. 23.350. So, app. : ὅπλα, πείρατα τέχνης (in which the exercise of art lies) Od. 3.433.

paratugxa/nw.head: παρατυγχάνω
paratugxa/nw.html: παρατυγχάνω [παρα- 2.] To be present with. With dat. : παρετύγχανε μαρναμένοισιν Il. 11.74.

pe/lwr.head: πέλωρ
pe/lwr.html: πέλωρ τό. A being of uncommon size or strength or of peculiarly daunting or portentous aspect (cf. πέλωρον). Of Hephaestus Il. 18.410. Of the Cyclops Od. 9.428. Of Scylla Od. 12.87.

pinuto/s.head: πινυτός
pinuto/s.html: πινυτός -ή [prob. fr. πνυ-. See πέπνυμαι.] Wise, of sound understanding, of good sense : ὅς τις π. γε μετέλθοι Od. 1.229. Cf. Od. 4.211, Od. 11.445, Od. 20.131, Od. 21.103, Od. 23.361.

penth/konta.head: πεντήκοντα
penth/konta.html: πεντήκοντα indeclinable [πέντε.] Fifty Il. 2.509, 556, 685, 719, Il. 4.393, Il. 5.786, Il. 6.244, Il. 11.678, 748, Il. 16.168, 170, Il. 23.147, Il. 24.495 : Od. 7.103, Od. 12.130, Od. 14.15, Od. 20.49, Od. 22.421, Od. 24.342. Absol. : παρʼ ἑκάστῳ ἥατο π. Il. 8.563. With another numeral : ἑκατὸν καὶ π. Il. 11.680 : δύω καὶ π. Od. 8.35, 48, Od. 16.247.

pe/rnhmi.head: πέρνημι
pe/rnhmi.html: πέρνημι [cf. περάω2.] 3 sing. pa. iterative πέρνασκε Il. 24.752. To export for sale, sell to foreign buyers : πολλὰ φρυγίην κτήματα περνάμενʼ ἵκει Il. 18.292. To sell into slavery : περνὰς νήσων ἔπι τηλεδαπάων Il. 22.45. Cf. Il. 24.752.

pe/leqron.head: πέλεθρον
pe/leqron.html: πέλεθρον -ου, τό. A measure (app. considerable) of length or area : ἐπʼ ἐννέα κεῖτο πέλεθρα Od. 11.577. Cf. Il. 21.407.

parqenopi/phs.head: παρθενοπίπης
parqenopi/phs.html: παρθενοπίπης [παρθένος + ὀπιπεύω.] One who ogles girls. Voc. παρθενοπῖπα Il. 11.385.

pu/rgos.head: πύργος
pu/rgos.html: πύργος -ου, ὁ. 1 A fortified wall securing a city or strong place; in pl., walls, ramparts : ἧντʼ ἐπὶ πύργῳ Il. 3.153, δείμομεν πύργους Il. 7.338. Cf. Il. 6.373, Il. 7.437 (hardly to be distinguished from τεῖχος), Il. 8.165, Il. 9.574, Il. 12.36, 332 (the part of the wall under his charge), Il. 15.737, Il. 16.700, Il. 18.274, Il. 22.97 (a projecting angle of the wall), Il. 24.443, etc. : Od. 6.262. Fig. of a person : τοῖός σφιν π. ἀπώλεο (so mighty a wall of defence was lost in thee) Od. 11.556. 2 A tower erected for defence on such a wall : φέρων σάκος ἠΰτε πύργον Il. 7.219=Il. 11.485=Il. 17.128. Cf. Il. 4.462. 3 A body of troops formed in line : δέκα πύργοι Ἀχαιῶν Il. 4.347, πάπτηνεν ἀνὰ πύργον Ἀχαιῶν (the line of defenders) Il. 12.333. Cf. Il. 4.334.

podw/khs.head: ποδώκης
podw/khs.html: ποδώκης -εος [ποδ-, πούς + ὠκύς.] Swift-footed : ἵππους Il. 2.764, Il. 17.614. Cf. Il. 10.316, Il. 23.262 (app. with transference of epithet from horses to drivers), 376. Epithet of Achilles Il. 2.860, Il. 8.474, Il. 13.113, Il. 16.134, Il. 17.486, Il. 18.234, etc. : Od. 11.471, 538.

polu/xrusos.head: πολύχρυσος
polu/xrusos.html: πολύχρυσος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + χρυσός.] Rich in gold Il. 10.315. Of places Il. 7.180, Il. 11.46, Il. 18.289 : Od. 3.304.

plekto/s.head: πλεκτός
plekto/s.html: πλεκτός -ή, -όν [πλεκ-, πλέκω.] Formed by plaiting or twisting, plaited, twisted : ταλάροισιν (i.e. of wicker-work) Il. 18.568. Cf. Il. 22.469: Od. 9.247, Od. 22.175 = 192.

polu/knhmos.head: πολύκνημος
polu/knhmos.html: πολύκνημος [πολυ-, πολύς + κνημός.] With many mountain-spurs, hilly : Ἐτεωνόν Il. 2.497.

proxe/w.head: προχέω
proxe/w.html: προχέω [προ- 1.] To pour forth Il. 21.219. In pass., of bodies of men, to pour or stream in a specified direction : τῇ προχέοντο πεφυζότες Il. 21.6. Cf. Il. 2.465, Il. 15.360.

pru/mnh.head: πρύμνη
pru/mnh.html: πρύμνη ἡ [πρυμνός.] 1 The stern (of a ship) : τῆς (sc. νηὸς) πρύμνη ἀείρετο Od. 13.84. Without νηός, a ship's stern : ἐν πρύμνῃ καθέζετο Od. 15.285. Cf. Il. 1.409, Il. 8.475, Il. 14.32, Il. 15.385, Il. 16.124, Il. 18.76, 447. 2 In apposition with νηῦς : νηῒ πάρα πρύμνῃ Ἀγαμέμνονος (by the stern of . . . 's ship) Il. 7.383. Cf. Il. 10.35, 570, Il. 11.600, Il. 12.403, Il. 13.333, 762, Il. 14.51, 65, Il. 15.248, 435, 704, 722, Il. 16.286, Il. 19.135 : Od. 2.417, Od. 12.411, Od. 13.75 (at the stern), Od. 15.206, 223.

parakli/nw.head: †παρακλίνω
parakli/nw.html: †παρακλίνω [παρα- 4.] Aor. pple. παρακλίνας. 1 To bend or turn (something) aside : κεφαλήν Od. 20.301. 2 To turn aside, deviate from the course, swerve Il. 23.424.

propodi/zw.head: προποδίζω
propodi/zw.html: προποδίζω [προ- 1 + ποδίζω, fr. ποδ-, πούς.] To set the foot forward, to advance, march along Il. 13.158, 806.

prwizo/s.head: πρωϊζός
prwizo/s.html: πρωϊζός [πρῶϊ.] In neut. pl. πρωϊζά as adv., just before : χθιζά τε καὶ π. Il. 2.303 (see χθιζός 3).

parati/qhmi.head: †παρατίθημι
parati/qhmi.html: †παρατίθημι [παρα- 2.] 1 pl. fut. παραθήσομεν Il. 23.810. Aor. παρέθηκα Od. 9.326. 3 sing. παρέθηκε Il. 11.779 : Od. 1.139, 141, Od. 4.133, Od. 14.76, Od. 18.120, Od. 21.29, etc. 3 pl. aor. πάρθεσαν (παρ-, παρα-) Od. 4.66. Imp. παράθες Il. 18.408. Aor. opt. mid. παραθείμην Od. 15.506, Od. 19.150. 3 sing. παραθεῖτο Od. 2.105, Od. 24.140. Nom. pl. masc. pple. παρθέμενοι Od. 2.237, Od. 3.74, Od. 9.255. From παρτιθέω 3 sing. pres. παρτιθεῖ Od. 1.192. 1 To set or place beside a person : ἐπεὶ δαίδας παραθεῖτο (παραθείμην) (had had them set) Od. 2.105= Od. 24.140, Od. 19.150. Cf. Od. 5.92. To set or place beside. With dat. : τράπεζαν, τὴν ἥν οἱ παρέθηκεν Od. 21.29. Cf. Od. 4.133, Od. 9.326. To set (food or drink) before a person : ξείνιά τʼ εὖ παρέθηκεν Il. 11.779. Cf. Od. 1.139, 141, Od. 18.120, etc. To set (food or drink) before. With dat. : ἀμφιπόλῳ, ἥ οἱ βρῶσίν τε πόσιν τε παρτιθεῖ Od. 1.192. Cf. Il. 18.408, Il. 23.810 : Od. 4.66, Od. 14.76, Od. 16.49. In mid. Od. 15.506. 2 In mid., to set at hazard, risk (cf. παραβάλλω) : σφὰς παρθέμενοι κεφαλάς Od. 2.237. Cf. Od. 3.74= Od. 9.255.

pansudi/h|.head: πανσυδίῃ
pansudi/h|.html: πανσυδίῃ [παν-, πᾶς + συ-, σεύω. Cf. ἐπασσύτερος.] Coming all together, in a body, in full force Il. 2.12, 29 = 66, Il. 11.709, 725.

pamfai/nw.head: παμφαίνω
pamfai/nw.html: παμφαίνω [reduplicated fr. φαίνω.] To shine, gleam, glitter : ἀστέρα, ὅς τε μάλιστα λαμπρὸν παμφαίνῃσιν Il. 5.6, στήθεσι παμφαίνοντας (app., their (naked) breasts glistening (instead of their armour)) Il. 11.100. Cf. Il. 6.513, Il. 11.30, 63, Il. 14.11, Il. 19.398, Il. 22.26.

pra/ktios.head: Πράκτιος
pra/ktios.html: Πράκτιος A river (now Bergaz Chai) flowing into the Hellespont on the Asiatic side Il. 2.835.

polu/ippos.head: πολύϊππος
polu/ippos.html: πολύϊππος [πολυ-, πολύς + ἵππος.] Rich in horses : μέντορος Il. 13.171.

pappa/zw.head: παππάζω
pappa/zw.html: παππάζω [πάππα.] To call one (dear) father : οὐδέ τί μιν παῖδες παππάζουσιν Il. 5.408.

peraiboi/.head: Περαιβοί
peraiboi/.html: Περαιβοί Greek. (μενοπτόλεμοι). A people of north Thessaly led by Gouneus Il. 2.749.

pa/ssw.head: πάσσω
pa/ssw.html: πάσσω (ἐμ-) 1 To let fall in shreds or small particles, sprinkle : φάρμακα Il. 4.219, Il. 5.401, 900, Il. 11.515, 830, Il. 15.394, ἁλός (partitive genit.) Il. 9.214. 2 In weaving, to insert in a web Il. 22.441.

purghdo/n.head: πυργηδόν
purghdo/n.html: πυργηδόν [πύργος.] In line : π. σφέας αὐτοὺς ἀρτύναντες Il. 12.43 (in line of battle). Cf. Il. 13.152, Il. 15.618.

proia/ptw.head: †προϊάπτω
proia/ptw.html: †προϊάπτω [προ- 1 + (ϝ)ι-(ϝ)άπτω, to throw. Cf. ἀπτοεπής, ἑάφθη.] 3 sing. fut. προϊάψει Il. 6.487. Infin. προϊάψειν Il. 5.190, Il. 11.55. 3 sing. aor. προΐαψε Il. 1.3. To send, dispatch: πολλὰς ψυχὰς Ἄϊδι Il. 1.3. Cf. Il. 5.190, Il. 6.487, Il. 11.55.

puloigenh/s.head: Πυλοιγενής
puloigenh/s.html:
Πυλοιγενής [locative of Πύλος + γεν-, γίγνομαι.] Born at Pylus, sprung from Pylus : βασιλῆος Il. 2.54, ἵπποι Il. 23.303.
Πυλοιγενής See Lexicon.

pari/sthmi.head: παρίστημι
pari/sthmi.html: παρίστημι [παρ-, παρα- 2.] 2 sing. aor. παρ-έστης Il. 3.405, Il. 5.116, Il. 10.290. 3 sing. παρέστη Il. 15.442, 483, 649, Il. 22.371, Il. 24.303 : Od. 1.335, Od. 9.52, Od. 17.73, Od. 18.211, Od. 21.66. 3 dual subj. παρστήετον Od. 18.183. 2 sing. opt. παρασταίης Od. 13.389. 3 sing. παρσταίη Il. 20.121. 3 pl. παρασταῖεν Od. 8.218. 2 pl. imp. πάρστητε Il. 16.544. Pple. παραστάς Il. 2.189, Il. 6.75, Il. 11.261, Il. 16.114, Il. 20.375, Il. 23.155, etc. : Od. 8.238, Od. 9.325, Od. 16.338, Od. 17.221, Od. 21.379, etc. παρστάς Il. 10.157. Fem. παρστᾶσα Od. 23.87. 3 sing. pf. παρέστηκε Il. 16.853, Il. 24.132. 3 pl. plupf. παρέστασαν Il. 7.467. Infin. παρεστάμεναι Il. 15.255, Il. 17.563, Il. 21.231 : Od. 4.827, Od. 20.94. Mid. Imp. παρίσταο Il. 10.291. Fut. infin. παραστήσεσθαι Od. 24.28. I In aor. and mid. 1 To take up a position, take one's stand, come and stand, by or beside a person or thing, come up to or approach a person : τὸν ἐρητύσασκε παραστάς Il. 2.189. Cf. Il. 3.405 (have come here), Il. 4.212, Il. 7.188, Il. 12.60, Il. 17.119, Il. 24.303 (presented herself), etc.: πέλεκυν ἔχων παρίστατο Od. 3.443. Cf. Od. 7.341, Od. 8.218, Od. 10.109, Od. 15.123, Od. 17.73 (went up to him), Od. 23.87, etc. To take up a position, take one's stand, come and stand, by or beside, come up to, approach. With dat. : τῷ παρίστατʼ Ὀδυσσεύς (came up to him) Il. 2.244. Cf. Il. 6.75, Il. 15.442, Il. 16.2, Il. 17.338, Il. 23.155, etc. : ἀμφίπολός οἱ ἑκάτερθε παρέστη Od. 1.335. Cf. Od. 2.384, Od. 12.43, Od. 15.104, Od. 17.221, Od. 18.183, etc. 2 To come and stand by a person as a helper, to come to his aid or support : ἀλλά, φίλοι, πάρστητε Il. 16.544. To come and stand by as a helper, to come to the aid or support of, aid, succour, support, protect. With dat. : ἡμείων τις Ἀχιλῆϊ παρσταίη Il. 20.121. Cf. Il. 5.116, 570, Il. 10.279, Il. 15.442, Il. 23.783, etc. : Od. 3.222, Od. 13.301, 389. 3 Of fate, to come upon. With dat. : Διὸς αἶσα παρέστη ἡμῖν Od. 9.52. Cf. Od. 16.280, Od. 24.28. II In pf. and plupf. 1 To have one's stand, stand, be, by or beside. With dat. : δόκησέ οἱ παρεστάμεναι κεφαλῆφιν Od. 20.94. 2 To stand by a person as a helper, to aid, succour, support, protect him Od. 4.827. To stand by as a helper, to aid, succour, support. With dat. : παρεστάμεναι καὶ ἀμύνειν πατρόκλῳ Il. 17.563. Cf. Il. 15.255, Il. 21.231. 3 Of fate, to be at hand, impend over. With dat. : ἄγχι τοι παρέστηκεν θάνατος καὶ μοῖρα Il. 16.853=Il. 24.132. 4 To be in an indicated place, be present, be there : νῆες ἐκ λήμνοιο παρέστασαν Il. 7.467.

pagxru/seos.head: παγχρύσεος
pagxru/seos.html: παγχρύσεος [παν-, πᾶς + χρύσεος.] All of gold : θύσανοι Il. 2.448.

pasiqe/h.head: Πασιθέη
pasiqe/h.html: Πασιθέη A grace beloved by Hypnos Il. 14.269, promised to him by Hera 276.

polupoi/ths.head: Πολυποίτης
polupoi/ths.html: Πολυποίτης (κρατερός, μενοπτόλεμος ). Son of Peirithous and Hippodameia-1. With Leonteus leader of the men of Argissa, etc. Il. 2.740 ; Il. 6.29; his defence with Leonteus of the wall Il. 12.129, 182; wins the prize in putting the weight Il. 23.836, 844, 848.

profai/nw.head: προφαίνω
profai/nw.html: προφαίνω [προ- 1.] Impf. act. and pass. προὔφαινον, προὐφαινόμην. Acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. pass. προφανέντα Od. 24.160. Nom. dual προφανέντε Il. 24.332. Acc. προφανέντε Il. 8.378, Il. 17.487. 3 sing. pf. προπέφανται Il. 14.332. 1 To show forth, show, display : τέραα Od. 12.394. 2 Intrans., to give forth light, be visible : οὐδὲ σελήνη προὔφαινεν Od. 9.145. 3 In pass., to come into view, appear, make one's appearance, present oneself : προφανέντε ἀνὰ πτολέμοιο γεφύρας Il. 8.378, τὰ προπέφανται ἅπαντα (lie open to view) Il. 14.332. Cf. Il. 17.487, Il. 24.332 : Od. 13.169, Od. 24.160.–Impers. : οὐδὲ προὐφαίνετʼ ἰδέσθαι (there was not light enough to see) Od. 9.143.

ptwska/zw.head: πτωσκάζω
ptwska/zw.html: πτωσκάζω [πτώσσω.] =πτώσσω. (1) Il. 4.372.

proma/xomai.head: προμάχομαι
proma/xomai.html: προμάχομαι [προ- 2.] To fight in front of the others Il. 17.358. To fight in front of. With genit.: ἁπάντων (to advance beyond them) Il. 11.217.

paratre/w.head: †παρατρέω
paratre/w.html: †παρατρέω [παρα- 4.] 3 pl. aor. παρέτρεσσαν. To rush aside in affright : παρέτρεσσάν οἱ ἵπποι Il. 5.295.

progi/gnomai.head: †προγίγνομαι
progi/gnomai.html: †προγίγνομαι [προ- 1.] 3 pl. aor. προγένοντο. To come forward, appear, come in sight Il. 18.525.

pla/zw.head: πλάζω
pla/zw.html: πλάζω [πλαγ-. Cf. πληγή, πλήσσω.] 3 sing. aor. πλάγξε Od. 24.307. Fut. mid. πλάγξομαι Od. 15.312. 3 sing. aor. pass. πλάγχθη Il. 11.351 : Od. 1.2. Pple. πλαγχθείς, -έντος Il. 14.120 : Od. 6.278, Od. 13.278. (ἀπο-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-) 1 To beat upon : κῦμα πλάζʼ ὤμους Il. 21.269 : δύω νύκτας κύματι πλάζετο (was beaten upon, tossed, by the waves) Od. 5.389. 2 To drive or turn from one's or its course, cause to take another or an undesired course : δαίμων με πλάγξʼ ἀπὸ σικανίης δεῦοʼ ἐλθέμεν Od. 24.307. Cf. Il. 17.751 : Od. 1.2 (was tossed about), 75, Od. 13.278. To drive back from one's goal, foil, baffle : ἐπίκουροι, οἵ με μέγα πλάζουσιν Il. 2.132. To drive, force to flee, from a place : Ἄργεϊ νάσθη πλαγχθείς Il. 14.120. To daze : πλάζε [μνηστῆρας] πίνοντας Od. 2.396. 3 In mid. and pass., to wander, rove, roam : εἰ ἄλλου μῦθον ἄκουσας πλαζομένου [Ὀδυσσῆος] (have heard from some one else the story of his wanderings) Od. 3.95= Od. 4.325, πλαζόμενοι κατὰ ληΐδα Od. 3.106. Cf. Il. 10.91 : Od. 3.252, Od. 13.204, Od. 14.43, Od. 15.312, Od. 16.64, 151. To stray, lose one's way : πλαγχθέντα ἧς ἀπὸ νηός Od. 6.278. Of a missile, to glance off : πλάγχθη ἀπὸ χαλκόφι χαλκός Il. 11.351.

paidofo/nos.head: παιδοφόνος
paidofo/nos.html: παιδοφόνος [παιδ-, παῖς + φον-, *φένω.] Slayer of one's sons Il. 24.506.

pronoe/w.head: προνοέω
pronoe/w.html: προνοέω [προ- 3.] 1 To perceive or detect beforehand, have an inkling of: δόλον Il. 18.526. 2 To think of, devise Od. 5.364.

paroi/teros.head: παροίτερος
paroi/teros.html: παροίτερος -η [comp. fr. *πάροι. See πάροιθε.] More forward, in front, leading : ἄλλοι μοι δοκέουσι παροίτεροι ἔμμεναι ἵπποι Il. 23.459. Cf. Il. 23.480.

prosba/llw.head: προσβάλλω
prosba/llw.html: προσβάλλω προτιβάλλω [προσ- 3.] 1 To smite. Of the rays of the sun : Ἠέλιος νέον προσέβαλλεν ἀρούρας Il. 7.421 := Od. 19.433. 2 In mid., to give heed to, direct one's attention to : ταύτην οὐ προτιβάλλεαι Il. 5.879.

polu/xalkos.head: πολύχαλκος
polu/xalkos.html: πολύχαλκος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + χαλκός.] 1 Rich in bronze Il. 10.315. Of place Il. 18.289 : Od. 15.425. 2 Fig. of the heavens (cf. χάλκεον οὐρανόν Il. 17.425) Il. 5.504 : Od. 3.2.

poi=os.head: ποῖος
poi=os.html: ποῖος -η, -ον. 1 Of what nature, kind, or sort ? ποῖοί κʼ εἶτʼ Ὀδυσῆϊ ἀμυνέμεν; (what sort of helpers would he find you?) Od. 21.195. 2 Without special reference to nature, etc., what ? ποίῃ νηΐ σʼ ἤγαγον; Od. 16.222. Carrying on an indirect question : ἐρέσθαι ὁππόθεν οὗτος ἀνήρ, ποίης δʼ ἐξ εὔχεται εἶναι γαίης Od. 1.406. 3 Rather exclamatory than interrogative, expressing surprise or anger : ποῖον τὸν μῦθον ἔειπες (what a word is this that you have said !) Il. 1.552. Cf. Il. 4.350, Il. 8.209, etc. : Od. 1.64, Od. 3.230, Od. 21.168, etc. Absol. : ποῖον ἔειπες Il. 13.824. Cf. Il. 23.570 : Od. 2.85= Od. 17.406, Od. 2.243.

pe/nte.head: πέντε
pe/nte.html: πέντε indeclinable [cf. L. quinque, Eng. five.] Five Il. 10.317, Il. 16.171, Il. 18.481, Il. 20.270, Il. 23.833 : Od. 3.299, Od. 6.62.

pwta/omai.head: πωτάομαι
pwta/omai.html: πωτάομαι [πέτομαι. Cf. ποτάομαι.] To fly. Of missiles : λίθοι πωτῶντο θαμειαί Il. 12.287.

polupi=dac.head: πολυπῖδαξ
polupi=dac.html: πολυπῖδαξ -ακος [πολυ-, πολύς + πῖδαξ.] With many springs, many-fountained. Epithet of Mount Ida Il. 8.47, Il. 14.157, Il. 15.151, etc.

paratrwpa/w.head: παρατρωπάω
paratrwpa/w.html: παρατρωπάω [παρα- 4.] To bend the mind of, win over : θεοὺς θυέεσσι παρατρωπῶσιν Il. 9.500.

ptw/c.head: πτώξ
ptw/c.html: πτώξ πτωκός, ὁ [πτωκ-, πτώσσω. The cowering or timid animal.] A hare Il. 17.676. Joined with λαγωός : πτῶκα λαγωόν Il. 22.310.

presbugenh/s.head: πρεσβυγενής
presbugenh/s.html: πρεσβυγενής [πρέσβυς + γεν-, γίγνομαι.] The first-born: π. Ἀντηνορίσης (the first-born son of ...) Il. 11.249.

pw=ma.head: πῶμα
pw=ma.html: πῶμα -ατος, τό. A means of protecting or securing the contents of something : ἴδε π. (the lid) Od. 8.443. Cf. Il. 4.116 (the top), Il. 16.221 (the lid) : Od. 2.353 (with stoppers), Od. 8.447, Od. 9.314.

polu/forbos.head: πολύφορβος
polu/forbos.html: πολύφορβος -ον, and -η, -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + φορβή.] That feeds many. Epithet of the earth: γαῖαν πολυφόρβην Il. 9.568, πολυφόρβου γαίης Il. 14.200, 301.

potini/ssomai.head: ποτινίσσομαι
potini/ssomai.html: ποτινίσσομαι (ποτινίσομαι) [ποτι-, προσ- 2.] To come, be brought, to a specified place : ἐς Ὀρχομενόν Il. 9.381.

podalei/rios.head: Ποδαλείριος
podalei/rios.html: Ποδαλείριος (ἰητὴρ ἀγαθός). Son of Asclepius. With his brother Machaon chief surgeon of the Greeks and leader of the men of Tricca, etc. Il. 2.732, Il. 11.833.

poihto/s.head: ποιητός
poihto/s.html: ποιητός -ή, -όν [ποιέω.] 1 Made, constructed, fabricated : σάκεος πύκα ποιητοῖο Il. 18.608. Cf. Il. 5.466 : Od. 1.333= Od. 8.458= Od. 16.415= Od. 18.209= Od. 21.64, Od. 1.436, Od. 22.455. 2 Epithet of various products of art, well made, constructed or fabricated (εὐποίητος): δόμοις Il. 5.198, τρίποδος Il. 23.718. Cf. Il. 10.262, Il. 12.470, Il. 23.340 : Od. 13.306.

petew/n.head: Πετεών
petew/n.html: Πετεών A Boeotian town Il. 2.500.

perihxe/w.head: περιηχέω
perihxe/w.html: περιηχέω [περι- 1 + ἠχέω, fr. ἠχή.] To ring all round : περιήχησε χαλκός Il. 7.267.

pa/roiqe.head: πάροιθε
pa/roiqe.html: πάροιθε [*πάροι, locative adv.(cf. πάρος) + -θε 2.] 1 In front, before : π. λάμπετο δουρὸς αἰχμή (before him as he went) Il. 6.319=Il. 8.494. Cf. Il. 20.437 (at the point), Il. 23.213 (before them): Od. 7.125 (in the foreground), Od. 19.33 (going before them), 227 (app., on the face of the περόνη). Leading in a race Il. 23.498. With genit., in front of, before : π. αὐτοῖο καθέζετο Il. 1.360, 500. Cf. Il. 3.162, Il. 14.427, Il. 15.154 (into his presence), Il. 16.255 : Od. 4.625 = Od. 17.167, Od. 16.166. 2 In temporal sense. a Before the happening of something : π. εἰρύσατο ζωστήρ (before the arrow got so far) Il. 4.185. Cf. Il. 15.227 (before it came to that) : Od. 6.174 (ere that). b In time past, formerly : ἀλλοῖος ἠὲ π. Od. 16.181. Cf. Il. 23.20 = 180 : Od. 17.294. So τὸ π. : μᾶλλον ἔτʼ ἢ τὸ π. Od. 1.322. Cf. Od. 2.312, Od. 18.275.

pie/zw.head: πιέζω
pie/zw.html: πιέζω Aor. pple. pass. πιεσθείς Od. 8.336. 1 To press, squeeze, compress : βραχίονα Il. 16.510. Cf. Od. 4.287, Od. 12.174. 2 To grip, grasp : ἀστεμφέως ἐχέμεν μᾶλλόν τε πιέζειν Od. 4.419. 3 To load (with bonds), secure tightly : ἐν δεσμοῖς πιεσθείς Od. 8.336. Cf. Od. 12.164, 196.

polu/zugos.head: πολύζυγος
polu/zugos.html: πολύζυγος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + ζυγόν.] Having many benches : νηΐ Il. 2.293.

pandama/twr.head: πανδαμάτωρ
pandama/twr.html: πανδαμάτωρ [παν-, πᾶς + δαμάζω.] All-subduing (cf. δμήτειρα). Epithet of sleep Il. 24.5 : Od. 9.373.

poulubo/teira.head: πουλυβότειρα
poulubo/teira.html: πουλυβότειρα -ης [πουλυ-, πουλύς + βοτ-, βόσκω.] That feeds many. Epithet of the earth Il. 3.89, 265, Il. 6.213, Il. 8.73, 277, Il. 12.158, etc.: Od. 8.378, Od. 12.191, Od. 19.408. Of Achaeïs Il. 11.770.

pro/domos.head: πρόδομος
pro/domos.html: πρόδομος -ου, ὁ [προ- 2 + δόμος.] A space in front of the door of the μέγαρον, app. the part of the line of the αἴθουσα into which the door opened: εὗρεν ἐνὶ προδόμῳ δέπα Od. 15.466. Cf. Il. 9.473 (see θάλαμος 1.a). Used as a sleeping-place for visitors Il. 24.673 (Priam and the herald in Achilles's dwelling):=Od. 4.302 (Telemachus and Pisistratus in Menelaus's house) (cf. Il. 24.644:=Od. 4.297). Cf. Od. 15.5, Od. 20.1 (the disguised Odysseus in his own house), 143 (the same in the same). A space in front of the door of the dwelling of Eumaeus Od. 14.5.

peta/nnumi.head: †πετάννυμι
peta/nnumi.html: †πετάννυμι 3 sing. aor. πέτασε Od. 5.269. 3 pl. πέτασαν Od. 6.94. πέτασσαν Il. 1.480 : Od. 4.783, Od. 8.54. 3 sing. opt. πετάσειε Od. 18.160. Pple. πετάσσας Il. 4.523, Il. 8.441, Il. 13.549, Il. 14.495, Il. 21.115 : Od. 1.130, Od. 5.374, Od. 9.417, Od. 10.506, Od. 24.397. Pass. 3 pl. aor. πετάσθησαν Od. 21.50. Nom. pl. fem. pple. πετασθεῖσαι Il. 21.538. 3 sing. pf. πέπταται Od. 6.45. 3 pl. πέπτανται Il. 5.195. Acc. pl. fem. pple. πεπταμένας Il. 21.531. 3 sing. plupf. πέπτατο Il. 17.371. (ἀνα-) 1 To spread, spread out, spread wide : ἀνʼ ἱστία πέτασσαν Il. 1.480. Cf. Il. 4.523 = Il. 13.549, Il. 5.195, Il. 8.441, Il. 14.495, Il. 21.115 : ὑπό λῖτα πετάσσας Od. 1.130. Cf. Od. 4.783, Od. 5.269, 374, Od. 6.94, Od. 8.54, Od. 9.417, Od. 10.506, Od. 24.397. Fig., app., to flutter or set agog : θυμὸν μνηστήρων Od. 18.160. 2 Of a gate or door, to open, throw open, open wide : πεπταμένας πύλας ἔχετε Il. 21.531. Cf. Il. 21.538 : Od. 21.50. 3 In pass., of clear sky, to be outspread over something : αἴθρη πέπταται Od. 6.45. Of light, to be shed, play : πέπτατʼ αὐγὴ ἠελίου Il. 17.371.

purh/.head: πυρή
purh/.html: πυρή -ῆς, ἡ [πῦρ.] 1 A funeral-pyre : πυραὶ νεκύων καίοντο θαμειαί Il. 1.52. Cf. Il. 4.99, Il. 7.336, 434, Il. 9.546, Il. 18.336, Il. 23.22, 141, 164, 165, 167, 172, 174, 192, 194, 210, 216, 217, 241, 256, Il. 24.787, 879 : Od. 24.69. 2 The fire of a sacrifice : πυρὴν ἐμπλησέμεν ἐσθλῶν Od. 10.523=Od. 11.31.

pa/sxw.head: πάσχω
pa/sxw.html: πάσχω [for πάθ-σκω.] Fut. in mid. form πείσομαι Od. 2.134. 3 sing. -εται Il. 20.127 : Od. 7.197. Infin. -εσθαι Od. 18.132. Aor. ἔπαθον Il. 9.492 : Od. 7.221. πάθον Il. 9.321, Il. 16.55, Il. 18.397 : Od. 4.95, Od. 5.223, Od. 8.155, Od. 13.263. 2 sing. ἔπαθες Il. 23.607. πάθες Od. 14.362, Od. 15.487. 3 sing. πάθε Il. 24.7 : Od. 1.4, Od. 13.90, Od. 14.32. 1 pl. πάθομεν Il. 21.442 : Od. 3.113. 2 pl. πάθετε Od. 10.458. 3 pl. ἔπαθον : Od. 8.490, Od. 23.67. πάθον Il. 14.67, Od. 3.116. Subj. πάθω Il. 11.404 : Od. 5.465, Od. 6.173. 2 sing. -ῃς Od. 17.596. -ῃσθα Il. 24.551. 3 sing. -ῃ Od. 15.401. -ῃσι Il. 11.470, Il. 17.242, Il. 20.126, Il. 22.505 : Od. 4.820, Od. 7.195. 1 pl. -ωμεν Il. 13.52 : Od. 12.321. 3 pl. -ωσι Il. 10.538. Opt. πάθοιμι Il. 19.321, Il. 21.274. 3 sing. -οι Il. 5.567, Il. 13.670, Il. 22.220 : Od. 18.224, Od. 19.464. 1 pl. -οιμεν Od. 9.53. 3 pl. -οιεν Il. 10.26. Pple. παθών, -όντος Il. 11.313, Il. 21.82 : Od. 2.174, Od. 4.81, Od. 5.377, Od. 7.224, Od. 8.184, Od. 12.27, Od. 13.131, Od. 15.176, Il. 16.205, Od. 24.106. Fem. παθοῦσα Il. 22.431. Infin. παθέειν Il. 17.32, Il. 18.77, Il. 20.198 : Od. 5.347. Pf. πέπονθα Od. 17.284. 2 sing. πέπονθας Od. 13.6. 2 pl. πέποσθε Od. 23.53. πέπασθε (for πέπαθ-τε : cf. πεπαθυίῃ below) Il. 3.99 : Od. 10.465. Dat. sing. fem. pple. πεπαθυίῃ Od. 17.555. 3 sing. plupf. ἐπεπόνθει Od. 13.92. 1 To suffer, endure, undergo, to have laid upon one, be called upon to bear : ἄλγεα Il. 2.667. Cf. Il. 3.99, 128, Il. 5.886, Il. 9.492, Il. 17.32, Il. 20.127, etc. : κακόν τι Od. 2.179. Cf. Od. 1.4, 49, Od. 2.174, Od. 4.81, 95, Od. 7.221, Od. 8.490, Od. 13.90, Od. 14.416, etc. Absol.: κακῶς πάσχοντος ἐμεῖο (sore though my plight be) Od. 16.275. 2 To have (something) come upon, happen to, or befall one : τί παθόντε λελάσμεθʼ ἀλκῆς; (why do we thus . .?) Il. 11.313, τί πάθω; (what is to become of me?) 404 : ἐξερέεινον ἅπαντα, οὐλὴν ὅττι πάθοι (about the wound, what befell him, i.e. how he got the wound) Od. 19.464. Cf. Od. 5.465, Od. 20.351, Od. 24.106 (what has brought you here?). 3 With indefinite object, to have (something evil) come upon one, encounter (mischance), meet (one's death) : μή τι πάθοι Il. 5.567. Cf. Il. 10.26, 538, Il. 11.470, Il. 13.52, Il. 17.242, Il. 20.126, Il. 21.274 : οὐδέ τί τοι παθέειν δέος Od. 5.347. Cf. Od. 4.820, Od. 12.321, Od. 17.596, Od. 18.224.

polu/dwros.head: πολύδωρος
polu/dwros.html:
πολύδωρος -ον [πολυ-, πολύς + δῶρον.] Bringing (her parents) a great bride-price (cf. ἀλφεσίβοιος); or perh., bountiful (cf. ἠπιόδωρος) : ἄλοχος Il. 6.394, Il. 22.88 : Od. 24.294.
Πολύδωρος-1 (ἀντίθεος). Patronymic Πριαμίδης. Son of Priam and Laothoe and brother of Lycaon-2. Killed by Achilles Od. 3.407, 419, Il. 21.91 ; Il. 22.46.
Πολύδωρος-2. Nestor beat him at spear-throwing Il. 23.637.

poludw/rh.head: Πολυδώρη
poludw/rh.html: Πολυδώρη (καλή). Daughter of Peleus, wife of Borus-2, and by the Spercheius mother of Menesthius-2 Il. 16.175.

pei/roos.head: Πείροος
pei/roos.html: Πείροος Πείρως. Genit. Πείρεω 484. Trojan. Patronymic Ἰμβρασίδης. Father of Rhigmus. A leader of the Thracians Il. 2.844; slays Diores-1 Il. 4.520, 525, killed by Thoas-1 527; Od. 3.484.

pano/ph.head: Πανόπη
pano/ph.html: Πανόπη A Nereid Il. 18.45 .

pla/taia.head: Πλάταια
pla/taia.html: Πλάταια A Boeotian town Il. 2.504.

proba/llw.head: †προβάλλω
proba/llw.html: †προβάλλω [προ- 1, προ- 2.] 3 sing. pa. iterative προβάλεσκε Od. 5.331. Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. προ-βαλόντες Il. 11.529. 3 pl. aor. mid. προβάλοντο Il. 1.458, Il. 2.421, Il. 23.255: Od. 3.447.
